## Service: social-planner (Social Planner API v3)

Documentation for Social Planner API

**API Version v3**

All APIs available via `/v3` route prefix with AIP-compliant responses.

### Apply watermark to an image
POST /social-media-posting/{locationId}/watermarks/add-image-watermark
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/{locationId}/watermarks/add-image-watermark
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/add-watermark-on-image | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/add-watermark-on-image.md

Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Apply a watermark to an image using either a specific template ID or by resolving the template bound to a specific connected account.

If the same watermark + image combination has been processed before, the response returns immediately with `status: completed` and the output URL in `message`. Otherwise, processing is queued and the response returns `status: pending` with a `progressId`.

**Rate limits:** This endpoint may be rate-limited to prevent abuse. To resolve a template dynamically at publish time, pass `accountId` — the endpoint will resolve the template bound to that connected account. Use the [Get Accounts](./get-account) endpoint to look up account IDs.

Processing is asynchronous — the response returns a `progressId` that identifies this preview job.

**Document fields:**
- `status`: 'pending' | 'processing' | 'completed' | 'failed'
- `outputMediaUrl`: string, available when `status` is `completed`
- `errorMessage`: string, available when `status` is `failed`

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/watermarks.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id

Request body (required) (application/json) AddImageWatermarkRequestDTO:
- templateId string (e.g. "665f1bac78fda9b6c5f48012") - Template ID to apply. Required if `accountId` is not provided.
- accountId string (e.g. "665f1bac78fda9b6c5f48099") - Connected account ID — the endpoint will resolve the template bound to this account. Required if `templateId` is not provided. Use the [Get Accounts](./get-account) endpoint to look up account IDs.
- inputMediaUrl* string (e.g. "http://example.com/media.mp4") - Input media URL (either video or image)
- mimeType string (enum: image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/png | image/gif | image/bmp | image/webp | image/tiff | image/svg+xml | image/vnd.microsoft.icon | image/heic | image/heif | video/mp4 | video/mpeg | video/webm | video/ogg | video/x-msvideo | video/x-ms-wmv | video/quicktime | video/x-flv | video/x-matroska | video/3gpp; e.g. "image/png") - MIME type of the media
- postId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Optional post ID to associate the watermark output with
- watermarkId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Optional cache key to fetch a previously-generated watermark result
- updatePost boolean - Whether to update or create the linked post after watermarking

Response 200 (Watermark processing initiated or cached result returned.) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- message* string - Message
- results object - Async processing result
  - progressId* string - Progress ID identifying this asynchronous preview job
  - status* string (enum: pending | processing | completed | failed) - Current processing status
  - message* string - Status message
  - outputMediaUrl string - URL of the watermarked output. Present only when status is completed (or on cache hit)

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Connect Account (Step 3 of 3)
POST /social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/{platform}/accounts/{accountId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/{platform}/accounts/{accountId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/attach-oauth-accounts | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/attach-oauth-accounts.md

Scheduled for removal in a future version.

**OAuth Connection Flow - Step 3: Connect the Account**

This is the final step in the OAuth flow. After retrieving available accounts (Step 2), use this endpoint to connect the selected account to your location.

**OAuth Flow Summary**

1. **Start OAuth** → User authenticates with platform
2. **Get Accounts** → Retrieved available pages/channels
3. **Attach Account** (this endpoint) → Connect the selected account

**Request Body**

The accepted fields depend on the `platform` path parameter — pick the matching schema in the request body below. Most platforms take the `originId`, `name` and optional `avatar` of the account you selected in Step 2; Google Business Profile takes the full `location` and `account` objects.

> `tiktok-business` accounts are connected through the TikTok Business flow, not this endpoint.

**After Connection**

Once connected, the account will appear in your location's connected accounts and can be used for social media posting.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/oauth.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- platform* string (enum: google | facebook | instagram | threads | bluesky | linkedin | tiktok | tiktok-business | youtube | pinterest; e.g. "facebook") - Social media platform. Must match the platform used in the preceding steps of the OAuth flow.
- locationId* string (e.g. "w37swmmLbA02zgqKPpxITe2") - The Location ID where you want to connect this social account
- accountId* string (e.g. "w37swmmLbA02zgqKPpxITe") - The OAuth Account ID received from Step 1 (Start OAuth) via the window message event

### Bulk Delete Social Planner Posts
POST /social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts/bulk-delete
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts/bulk-delete
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/bulk-delete-social-planner-posts | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/bulk-delete-social-planner-posts.md

Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Deletes multiple posts based on the provided list of post IDs. 
                  This operation is useful for clearing up large numbers of posts efficiently. 
                  
Note: 
                  
1.The maximum number of posts that can be deleted in a single request is '50'.
                  
2.However, It will only get deleted in the platform database but still
                   it is recommended to be cautious of this operation.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/post.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID (also known as Sub-Account ID) for the business location.

Request body (required) (application/json) DeletePostsDto:
- postIds string[] (e.g. ["662791ee3f216822d7da0c8c"]) - Post identifiers to delete. Each is either a 24-char post id or a 40-char native post id.

Response 201 (Posts deleted successfully) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- message* string - Message
- results* object - Message and deleted count
  - message* string - Result message
  - deletedCount number - Number of posts successfully deleted

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422, 500 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Cannot delete more than 50 posts at a time.) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 404 (No posts found with the given IDs.): no body
Response 500 (An error occurred while trying to delete the posts. Please try again later.): no body

### Clone a queue item
POST /social-media-posting/category/queues/{queueId}/items/{itemId}/clone
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/category/queues/{queueId}/items/{itemId}/clone
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/clone-queue-item | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/clone-queue-item.md

Duplicates an existing queue item at a specified order position. Requires an active edit session.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/category.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- queueId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Category queue ID
- itemId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Queue item ID

Request body (required) (application/json) CloneQueueItemDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "609e126a1c4ae1001291e1b5") - Location ID
- sessionId* string (e.g. "60af88475f1b2c001f5d5f4b") - Edit session ID
- order* number (e.g. 1.5) - Order for the cloned item (typically between source and next item)

Response 201 (Queue item cloned successfully.) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- results* object - Response payload
  - message string - Message
  - queueItem object - The cloned queue item
    - _id string - The unique identifier of the queue item.
    - order number - The order of the item in the queue.
    - variations object[] - A list of content variations for the post.
      - _id string - The ID of the variation.
      - content string - The text content of the variation.
      - mentions object[] - Platform-specific mentions within the content (e.g., @username references).
      - ogTags object - Open Graph tags for link previews.
        - metaLink string - The canonical URL of the content.
        - metaImage string - URL of the content's primary image.
        - ogTitle string - The title of the content.
    - primaryImage string - The primary image URL for the post.
    - lastScheduledTime string (format: date-time; nullable) - Timestamp of the last scheduled post. Always null for a new queue.
    - queueId string - The ID of the queue this post belongs to
    - postId string - The ID of the original post, if any.
    - modifiedPostPayload object - The formatted post data modified from original post.
      - _id string - Unique identifier of the post
      - source string (enum: composer | csv | recurring | review | rss | template-library | category-queue | native) - source must be one of the following values: composer, recurring, csv
      - locationId* string - Location Id
      - displayDate string (format: date-time) - Display date for the post
      - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was created
      - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was last updated
      - accountId string - Account Id
      - error* string - Error
      - postId string - Platform-specific post identifier
      - previewLink string - Direct link to view the published post on the native platform. Populated once the post is published on a platform that returns a permalink; `null` for posts that are not yet published (draft, scheduled, failed) or on platforms that do not return a link.
      - insights object - Aggregated engagement metrics for the published post. Populated asynchronously by the insights sync workers for supported platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube). Absent on posts that have not been synced yet or on platforms where insights are not supported.
        - like number - Number of likes on the published post
        - share number - Number of shares of the published post
        - comment number - Number of comments on the published post
      - publishedAt string - Date when the post was published
      - thumbnail string - Post-level cover image (thumbnail) URL. For posts that contain a video, this is the resolved cover image used for the first video in `media[]`. It is set automatically from the `thumbnail` provided on the first video media item at create/edit time, or auto-generated from the video when one is not supplied. Per-item thumbnails inside `media[]` are not retained on the response — the primary cover image lives on this field.
      - accountIds string[] - Account Ids
      - summary string - Content text of the post
      - media object[] - Post Media Data The limitations of media as per the platforms is provided through the reference link in API description
        - url* string - Public URL of the media file. Must be a valid, accessible HTTPS URL.
        - caption string - Alt text or caption for the media. Used for accessibility and SEO.
        - originalUrl string - Original media URL before any processing (watermarking/optimization). Set automatically by the system.
        - watermarkedUrl string - URL of the media after watermarking. Set automatically when watermark is applied.
        - type* string (enum: image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/png | image/gif | video/mp4 | video/mov | video/webm) - MIME type of the media file. See Platform Limitations Guide for platform-specific format support.
        - thumbnail string - Cover image URL for a video media item. **Scope** - Applies to the **first video** in `media[]`. Values supplied on subsequent video items are ignored. - Has no effect on image-only media items. **Response behavior** - After the post is published, the resolved cover image is surfaced on the post-level `thumbnail` field of the response and is no longer echoed back inside `media[]`. This represents the post's primary cover image and the cover used for the first video. **Limitations** - Per-item thumbnails for multi-video posts are not supported. Each destination network exposes a single cover image per post for the leading video; this matches the behavior of the underlying social platform APIs. **Format** - Provide a publicly accessible JPEG or PNG URL. Animated formats and video URLs are not accepted. - Recommended: an image matching the orientation of your video and ≤ 2 MB.
        - defaultThumb string - Default thumbnail URL, auto-generated from video if not provided.
        - id string - Unique identifier for the media item. Used for tracking and referencing.
        - optimizedUrl string - URL of the optimized/compressed media. Set automatically when media optimization is enabled. **Enable Optimization:** Set `mediaOptimization: true` in the post request.
        - optimizedType string - MIME type of the optimized media. May differ from original if format conversion occurred.
        - isModified boolean - Flag indicating if the media was modified (watermarked, optimized, or processed).
        - altText string - Alt text for accessibility. Supported on Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and LinkedIn image posts (ignored for video and other platforms). Auto-truncated per platform: Pinterest 500, Instagram/Threads 1000, Bluesky 2000, LinkedIn 4086 chars.
      - status string (enum: in_progress | draft | failed | published | scheduled | in_review | notification_sent | pending | deleted) - Status must be one of the following values: in_progress, draft, failed, published, scheduled, in_review, notification_sent, pending, deleted
      - createdBy string - User ID who created the post
      - type* string (enum: post | story | reel | short) - Post Type must be one of the following values: post, story, reel, short
      - tags string[] - Tag Ids
      - ogTagsDetails object - Og Tags Meta Data
        - metaImage string - Preview image URL for the shared link. **Best Practices:** - Use high-quality images (1200x630px recommended) - Ensure the image is publicly accessible **Auto-fetch:** Use the Get Metatags API to fetch OG data from a URL.
        - metaLink string - URL of the webpage being shared. This is the destination when users click the link preview.
        - ogTitle string - Custom title for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:title meta tag. **Tip:** Keep titles concise (50-60 characters) for best display across platforms.
        - ogDescription string - Custom description for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:description meta tag. **Tip:** Keep descriptions under 155 characters for optimal display.
      - postApprovalDetails object - Post Approval Details
        - approver string - User ID of the designated approver. **Note:** The approver will receive a notification when a post is submitted for review.
        - requesterNote string - Note from the post creator to the approver explaining the post or requesting specific feedback.
        - approverNote string - Note from the approver to the post creator with feedback or approval comments.
        - approvalStatus string (enum: pending | approved | rejected | not_required) - Current approval status of the post. **Available Values:** - `pending` - Awaiting approver review - `approved` - Approved and ready for publishing - `rejected` - Rejected by approver (needs revision) - `not_required` - No approval workflow needed
        - approverUser object - Approver User Details
          - id* string - User Id
          - title* string - Title
          - firstName* string - First name
          - lastName* string - Last name
          - profilePhoto* string - Profile photo
          - phone* string - Phone number
          - email* string - Email Id
      - tiktokPostDetails object - Tiktok Post Details
        - privacyLevel string (enum: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | SELF_ONLY) - Privacy level controlling who can view the video. **Available Values:** - `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` - Anyone can view (default) - `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS` - Only mutual followers can view - `SELF_ONLY` - Only you can view (private) **Note:** If set to `SELF_ONLY`, `videoDisclosure` must be `false`.
        - promoteOtherBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes a third-party brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting another brand.
        - enableComment boolean - Allow users to comment on the video. Default is determined by account settings.
        - enableDuet boolean - Allow users to create Duet videos with your content. **Duet:** Side-by-side video featuring your content and the creator's reaction/addition.
        - enableStitch boolean - Allow users to create Stitch videos with your content. **Stitch:** Clips up to 5 seconds of your video that creators can use in their own videos.
        - videoDisclosure boolean - Enable branded content disclosure. Required when video is promotional content. **Validations:** - Cannot be `true` if `privacyLevel` is `SELF_ONLY` - If enabled, at least one of `promoteYourBrand` or `promoteOtherBrand` must be `true`
        - promoteYourBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes your own brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting your own brand.
      - gmbPostDetails object - GMB Post Details
        - gmbEventType* string (enum: STANDARD | EVENT | OFFER) - Google My Business post type. **Available Types:** - `STANDARD` - Regular update post (What's New) - `EVENT` - Event announcement with dates and title - `OFFER` - Promotional offer with coupon and redemption details **Required fields by type:** - STANDARD: None additional - EVENT: `title`, `startDate`, `endDate` - OFFER: `offerTitle`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `termsConditions`, `couponCode`, `redeemOnlineUrl`
        - title string - Event title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `EVENT`. **Max length:** 58 characters
        - offerTitle string - Offer title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `OFFER`.
        - startDate object - Start date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Structure:** - `startDate`: { year, month, day } - `startTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
          - startDate object - Start Date
            - year* number - Year component of the date
            - month* number - Month component of the date (1-12)
            - day* number - Day component of the date (1-31)
          - startTime object - Start Time
            - hours* number - Hour component of the time (0-23)
            - minutes* number - Minute component of the time (0-59)
            - seconds* number - Second component of the time (0-59)
        - endDate object - End date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Validation:** Must be after `startDate`. **Structure:** - `endDate`: { year, month, day } - `endTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
          - endDate object - End Date
            - year* number - Year component of the date
            - month* number - Month component of the date (1-12)
            - day* number - Day component of the date (1-31)
          - endTime object - End Time
            - hours* number - Hour component of the time (0-23)
            - minutes* number - Minute component of the time (0-59)
            - seconds* number - Second component of the time (0-59)
        - termsConditions string - URL to terms and conditions page. Required for OFFER posts.
        - url string - Call-to-action URL. Required when `actionType` is set (except `none` and `call`). **Required for:** STANDARD and EVENT posts with actionType other than `none` or `call`.
        - couponCode string - Promotional coupon code. Required for OFFER posts.
        - redeemOnlineUrl string - URL where customers can redeem the offer online. Required for OFFER posts.
        - actionType string (enum: none | order | book | shop | learn_more | call | sign_up) - Call-to-action button type for the post. **Available Actions:** - `none` - No action button - `order` - Order online - `book` - Book appointment - `shop` - Shop now - `learn_more` - Learn more - `call` - Call now (no URL required) - `sign_up` - Sign up **Note:** All actions except `none` and `call` require a `url`.
      - blueskyPostDetails object - Bluesky Post Details
        - shortenedLinks string[] - Shortened links for the post (auto-generated).
        - replyTo string - Bluesky AT Protocol URI of a post to reply to. **Format:** `at://did:plc:{user-id}/app.bsky.feed.post/{post-id}` **Use Case:** Create a reply thread to an existing Bluesky post.
        - quotePost string - Bluesky AT Protocol URI of a post to quote. **Format:** `at://did:plc:{user-id}/app.bsky.feed.post/{post-id}` **Use Case:** Quote-post another user's post with your commentary.
        - language string - ISO 639-1 language code for the post content. **Examples:** `en` (English), `es` (Spanish), `fr` (French), `de` (German)
        - externalLink string - External URL to embed as a link card in the post.
        - externalLinkTitle string - Title for the external link card. Displayed prominently in the embed.
        - externalLinkDescription string - Description for the external link card. Brief summary displayed below the title.
      - user object - User
        - id* string - User Id
        - title* string - Title
        - firstName* string - First name
        - lastName* string - Last name
        - profilePhoto* string - Profile photo
        - phone* string - Phone number
        - email* string - Email Id
      - linkedinPostDetails object - Linkedin Post Details
        - pdfTitle string - Title for the PDF document carousel. Displayed as the document name on LinkedIn. **Max length:** 100 characters **Tip:** Use a descriptive title that explains the document content.
        - postAsPdf boolean - Post images as a PDF document carousel. **Limits:** - Max 300 pages/images - Max PDF size: 100 MB
        - poll object - Publish a LinkedIn poll post. **Required fields when `poll` is supplied:** - `question` (max 140 characters) - `options`: 2 to 4 entries, each `text` ≤ 30 characters; option texts must be unique - `settings.duration`: one of `ONE_DAY`, `THREE_DAYS`, `SEVEN_DAYS`, `FOURTEEN_DAYS` **LinkedIn restrictions:** - Polls cannot be edited after publishing. - A poll post cannot include `media` or a meta-link preview.
          - question* string (maxLength: 140) - Question for the poll. Max length: 140 characters.
          - options* object[] (minItems: 2; maxItems: 4) - Poll options. Minimum 2, maximum 4. Each option text max 30 characters. Option texts must be unique.
            - text* string (maxLength: 30) - Text describing the option. Max length: 30 characters.
          - settings* object - Poll settings (duration).
            - duration* string (enum: ONE_DAY | THREE_DAYS | SEVEN_DAYS | FOURTEEN_DAYS) - Duration the poll stays open for votes.
      - pinterestPostDetails object - Pinterest Post Details
        - title string - Pin title displayed on Pinterest. **Max length:** 100 characters **Best Practices:** - Include relevant keywords - Be descriptive and engaging
        - link string - Destination URL for the pin. Users clicking the pin will be directed to this URL. **Max length:** 2048 characters **Best Practices:** - Use direct links to relevant content - Track with UTM parameters for analytics
        - boardIds map<string, string> (deprecated) - **DEPRECATED — use `pinterestBoards` instead.** Will be removed on July 31, 2026. Legacy mapping of Pinterest account OAuth IDs to a single board ID: `{ accountOAuthId: "boardId" }` For multi-board posting, use `pinterestBoards`.
        - pinterestBoards object[] - Per-account Pinterest board selection. Each entry binds one connected Pinterest account to a list of boards on that account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account. When supplied, this field takes precedence over the deprecated `boardIds` field.
          - accountId* string - Connected Pinterest account ID. Must match one of the accounts referenced in the post's `userIds`.
          - boards* string[] - Pinterest board IDs to publish to on this account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account.
        - shortenedLinks string[] - Shortened links for the post (auto-generated).
      - facebookPostDetails object - Facebook Post Details
        - type* string (enum: post | story | reel) - Facebook post format type. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, text) - `story` - 24-hour temporary story - `reel` - Short-form vertical video **Restrictions:** - Reels: Require exactly 1 video, not supported on Groups - Stories: Captions not supported
        - textFormatPresetId string - Facebook background preset ID for text-only feed posts. **Facebook `post` only** — not `story` or `reel`. Ignored when media is attached; `metaLink` is omitted on publish. **Validations** — request returns `400` if violated: - Must be a valid preset ID from the [Facebook text background preset reference](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008005-facebook-text-background-posts-preset-reference). Empty strings, whitespace-only values, and `null` are rejected. - When set, `summary` must be 130 characters or fewer.
      - instagramPostDetails object - Instagram Post Details
        - type* string (enum: post | story | reel) - Instagram post format type. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, carousels) - `story` - 24-hour temporary story - `reel` - Short-form vertical video (up to 90 seconds) **Restrictions:** - Media is REQUIRED for all Instagram posts - Reels: Require exactly 1 video - Stories: Captions not supported, JPEG only for images
        - collaborators object - Collaboration invites mapping account IDs to Instagram usernames. **Structure:** `{ accountId: [username1, username2, username3] }` - **Key:** Account ID from `accountIds` array (the Instagram account posting) - **Value:** Array of Instagram usernames to invite as collaborators **Get Account IDs from:** [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) — use the `id` field from Instagram accounts. **✅ Supported for:** Posts and Reels only (NOT Stories) **Validations:** - Maximum 5 collaborators per account - No duplicate usernames allowed - Usernames are Instagram handles without @ **Use Case:** Invite other Instagram users to collaborate. Once accepted, the post appears on both profiles.
        - publishViaPushNotification boolean - Send Instagram Story via Push Notification instead of direct posting. Only applicable for Story type.
        - publisherNote string - Note to the publisher for manual posting guidance. Only used when publishViaPushNotification is true.
        - notificationSentCount number - Number of push notifications sent for this Instagram Story. Tracks how many notifications have been sent out.
        - postedVia string (enum: web | mobile) - Source of where the post was marked as published. Values: "web" (web interface), "mobile" (mobile app), or null.
        - showOnFeed boolean - Show Reel on profile grid/feed. **✅ Applies to:** Reels only - `true` - Reel appears on your profile grid - `false` - Reel only appears in Reels tab
      - youtubePostDetails object - Youtube Post Details
        - title string - Video title displayed on YouTube. **Max length:** 100 characters **Best Practices:** - Include relevant keywords - Be descriptive but concise - Avoid clickbait
        - privacyLevel string (enum: private | public | unlisted) - Video visibility/privacy setting. **Available Values:** - `public` - Anyone can search and view - `unlisted` - Only people with the link can view - `private` - Only you can view
        - type* string (enum: video | short) - YouTube video format type. **Available Types:** - `video` - Standard YouTube video (landscape, any duration) - `short` - YouTube Shorts (vertical, up to 60 seconds) **Required field.**
      - communityPostDetails object - Community Post Details
        - title* string - Title of the community post. Displayed as the post headline. **Max length:** 1,000 characters **Required:** Yes, for all Community posts.
        - notifyAllGroupMembers boolean - Notify every member of the group when the post is published, equivalent to an `@everyone` broadcast prepended to the post content. **Use Case:** Enable for announcements that all members should see. **Default:** `false`
        - postAsUser* object - The Community member each post is published as, keyed by Community account ID. **Structure:** `{ accountId: { id, name, avatar } }` - **Key** — the Community account ID. This is the same value you pass in `accountIds`: take it from the `id` field of a Community account in the Get Accounts API, not the `oauthId` field. - `id` (required) — `contactId` of the member to publish as, from the Get Community Members API. - `name` (optional) — display name shown as the post author. - `avatar` (optional) — profile image URL shown against the post. **Required:** Yes. Every Community account listed in `accountIds` must have an entry here, otherwise the request is rejected. **Member eligibility:** the member must be an active member of the group and hold a role in it. This is checked again at publish time, so a member who leaves the group or loses access between scheduling and publishing causes that post to fail. Use the Validate Community Member API to confirm a stored member is still eligible before scheduling. **Private channels:** list members per account rather than reusing one list across accounts — for a private channel only that channel's members may be posted as.
      - mediaOptimization boolean - Pass this parameter to optimize the image media
    - parentPostId string - The ID of the parent post before splitting to individual social posts.
    - errors string[] - List of errors associated with the queue item. Possible values: INVALID_USER_ID, PIXABAY_MEDIA.
    - currentVariation number - The index of the current variation being used for this post
    - createdAt string - Creation timestamp
    - updatedAt string - Last update timestamp
    - deleted boolean - Indicates if the item is deleted
    - locationId string - Location ID
- traceId string - Trace ID for debugging

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Create a comment or reply
POST /social-media-posting/comments/{platform}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/comments/{platform}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/create-comment | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/create-comment.md

Create a top-level comment on a post (`isParentThread: true`, `parentId` = postId) or a reply to an existing comment (`isParentThread: false`, `parentId` = commentId). Per-platform content max length: Facebook 8000, Instagram 2200, Linkedin 3000, Community 8000, Tiktok 150, Bluesky 300, Youtube 10000, Threads 500.

**Optional-field platform support:**
- `attachments` — supported on **Facebook only**. Ignored on Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Bluesky, Community (Community processes the field but external URLs are not rendered due to its bucket restriction).
- `mentions` — supported on **Facebook**, **LinkedIn**, and **Community** only. Ignored on Instagram, TikTok, Bluesky.
- `notifyAllGroupMembers` — supported on **Community** only. When `true`, all group members get a push/in-app notification (equivalent to an `@everyone` broadcast). Independent of the `mentions` array and of `@everyone` text in `content`. Default `false`.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/comments.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- platform* string (enum: facebook | instagram | linkedin | community | tiktok | bluesky | youtube | threads; e.g. "facebook") - Supported Comments Platforms

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "1234") - Location ID

Request body (required) (application/json) CommentsCreateBodyDTO:
- parentId* string (e.g. "6975b186f3442844ec07665b") - For top-level comments (`isParentThread: true`): pass the post ID returned by the posts API. For replies (`isParentThread: false`): pass the parent comment ID returned by the list-comments API. In both cases this must be a valid 24-character internal ID — not the native platform ID.
- isParentThread* boolean - Set `true` to create a top-level comment on a post (parentId = post ID). Set `false` to create a reply to an existing comment (parentId = comment ID).
- content* string (e.g. "Great post, Alex Morgan!") - Content of the comment. Per-platform max length: Facebook 8000, Instagram 2200, Linkedin 3000, Community 8000, Tiktok 150, Bluesky 300, Youtube 10000, Threads 500.
- attachments object[] - Attachments for the comment (max 1 image). **Supported on:** Facebook only. **Not supported on:** Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Bluesky, Community — the field is accepted by the API but the attachment will not appear on the comment. (Community processes the field server-side, but external URLs are not rendered due to its bucket restriction.)
  - url* string (e.g. "https://example.com/image.jpg") - URL of the attachment
  - type* string (enum: image; e.g. "image") - Type of the attachment
- mentions object[] - Mentions for the comment. **Supported on:** Facebook, LinkedIn, Community. **Ignored on:** Instagram, TikTok, Bluesky — the field is accepted but mentions are not rendered on these platforms. `offset`/`length` must locate `name` inside `content` exactly — `content.substring(offset, offset + length) === name` — otherwise the request is rejected with 400. The example below aligns with the `content` example above.
  - name* string (e.g. "Alex Morgan") - Mention name. Must appear verbatim in `content` at `offset`.
  - id* string (e.g. "102694781978972") - Mention ID
  - offset* number (e.g. 12) - Zero-based character index in `content` where `name` starts. For content `"Great post, Alex Morgan!"` the mention `"Alex Morgan"` starts at 12.
  - length* number (e.g. 11) - Character length of `name` — `content.substring(offset, offset + length)` must equal `name`.
  - slug string (e.g. "mohammed-marvan-8bRf3H") - Mention slug for community profile link
- notifyAllGroupMembers boolean - When `true`, all members of the Community group receive a push/in-app notification about this comment — equivalent to an `@everyone` broadcast. **Supported on:** Community only. Ignored on all other platforms (the field is accepted but no notification is sent). **Independent of the `mentions` array** — you do not need to add an `@everyone` entry to `mentions` for this to take effect. Conversely, putting the literal text `@everyone` in `content` does **not** by itself trigger notifications; only this flag does. Defaults to `false` (no broadcast notification). Use `true` only when the comment is genuinely intended for every member of the group — overuse may cause members to mute the group.
- pollOptions object - Poll options for Threads reply (2-4 options)
- textAttachment object - Text attachment for Threads reply with optional styling info
- threadLocationId string (e.g. "123456") - Location ID for Threads reply location tagging

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- message* string - Message
- results* object - The created comment
  - _id* string - Internal comment ID
  - platform* string - Platform the comment was posted on
  - platformCommentId string - Native platform comment ID
  - platformParentId string - Native platform parent ID (the post or comment this is a reply to)
  - platformPostId string - Native platform post ID
  - postId* string - Internal post ID
  - originId* string - Connected account / page ID on the native platform
  - isParentThread boolean - True if this comment is a top-level comment on the post; false if it is a reply to another comment
  - isPost* boolean - True if this record represents the root post (not a comment)
  - content string - Comment content. May be empty or missing for attachment-only comments.
  - attachments object[] - Attachments on the comment
    - type string - Attachment MIME type or platform-specific type
    - url string - Attachment URL
    - thumbnail string - Thumbnail URL
    - videoUrl string - Video URL (when attachment is a video)
  - author object - Author of the comment. May be partial or missing for some sync paths.
    - id string - Platform author ID
    - name string - Author display name
    - profilePic string - Author profile picture URL
  - level number - Comment depth (0 = post, 1 = comment, 2 = reply)
  - likeCount* number - Number of likes on the comment
  - reactionCount* number - Number of reactions on the comment
  - replyCount* number - Number of replies to the comment
  - shareCount* number - Number of shares of the comment
  - repostCount* number - Number of reposts of the comment (platform-specific)
  - quoteCount* number - Number of quote posts (platform-specific)
  - previewLink string - Direct link to view the comment on the native platform
  - isRead* boolean - Whether the comment has been read
  - isDeleted* boolean - Whether the comment was deleted
  - isEdited* boolean - Whether the comment was edited
  - publishedAt string (format: date-time) - Time the comment was published on the native platform. May be missing for legacy or webhook-synced records.
  - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Time the comment record was created in the system
  - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Time the comment record was last updated in the system

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Like a comment
POST /social-media-posting/comments/{platform}/{id}/like
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/comments/{platform}/{id}/like
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/create-like | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/create-like.md

Like a comment by its internal comment ID (the `_id` returned by the list-comments endpoint — not the native platform ID).

Works for any comment level — top-level comments, replies, and replies-to-replies. **Supported platforms:** Facebook, LinkedIn, Community, TikTok, Bluesky. Instagram is not supported (passing `instagram` returns 400).

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/comments.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- platform* string (enum: facebook | linkedin | community | tiktok | bluesky; e.g. "facebook") - Platform that supports liking / unliking comments (Instagram is not supported)
- id* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Internal comment ID — the `_id` returned by the list-comments endpoint (`POST /comments/{platform}/list`). Not the native platform comment ID. Works for any comment level: top-level comments, replies, and replies-to-replies.

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "1234") - Location ID

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- message* string - Message

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (State conflict (already liked) or unsupported platform (Instagram)) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string

### Create post
POST /social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/create-post | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/create-post.md

Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Create posts for all supported platforms. It is possible to create customized posts per channel by using the same platform account IDs in a request and hitting the create post API multiple times with different summaries and account IDs per platform.

The content and media limitations, as well as platform rate limiters corresponding to the respective platforms, are provided in the following reference link:

  Link: [Platform Limitations](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/48001240003-social-planner-image-video-content-and-api-limitations "Social Planner Help")

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/post.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID (also known as Sub-Account ID) for the business location.

Request body (required) (application/json) CreatePostDTO:
- accountIds string[] (e.g. ["aF3KhyL8JIuBwzK3m7Ly_iVrVJ2uoXNF0wzcBzgl5_12554616564525983496"]) - Account IDs for the post. Each account ID identifies a connected social media account. **Get IDs from:** [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) — use the `id` field from each account. **One request = one post, shared across every account in this list.** - All accounts share the same `summary` and the same `media` array. - `summary` is trimmed to the **strictest** character limit among the selected platforms. Adding a Bluesky account (300 chars) therefore trims the caption to 300 for Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn in that same request. - `media` is capped to each platform's own maximum at publish time (e.g. Bluesky publishes the first 4 items, Instagram the first 10). - **To keep full-length, platform-specific captions, send one request per platform** - one post per platform, each with only that platform's account IDs. **Validations:** - Required for non-draft posts - Must be a non-empty array - All account IDs must be valid connected accounts for the location
- summary string (e.g. "Hello World! Check out our latest updates. #social #marketing") - Post content/caption text. Character limits vary by platform. **Custom Values & Hashtags:** - You can include custom values/variables in the content (e.g., `{{contact.name}}`) - Hashtags: Use `#hashtag` format. Instagram allows max 30 hashtags. - Mentions: Use platform-specific mention format (see `mentions` field for structured mentions) **Validations:** - Instagram/Facebook Story: Caption NOT supported for direct publishing - Facebook, LinkedIn, GMB: Content OR media is required (at least one) **Trimming across multiple platforms:** One post carries ONE caption for every account in `accountIds`, so the caption is silently trimmed to the **strictest** limit among the selected platforms — not to each platform's own limit. - Facebook 63,206 · LinkedIn 3,000 · Instagram / TikTok 2,200 · Google 1,500 · Pinterest 800 · Threads 500 · **Bluesky 300** - Example: `accountIds` covering Facebook + Instagram + Bluesky trims the caption to **300 characters on all three**. - Instagram/Facebook Stories without push-notification publishing force the limit to 0, dropping the caption entirely. - **To keep the full caption on each platform, send one request per platform** instead of one request mixing platforms. **Reference:** [Platform Limitations Guide](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/48001240003-social-planner-image-video-content-and-api-limitations)
- media object[] - Post Media Data. Per-platform media limits are listed in the reference link in the API description. **Across multiple platforms:** the same media array is sent to every account in `accountIds` and capped to each platform's own maximum at publish time — the array is NOT reduced to the strictest limit the way `summary` is. An 8-item array publishes 8 items to Facebook and the first 4 to Bluesky. Send one request per platform if a platform needs a different set of media.
  - url* string - Public URL of the media file. Must be a valid, accessible HTTPS URL.
  - caption string (e.g. "Caption 1") - Alt text or caption for the media. Used for accessibility and SEO.
  - originalUrl string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/test/media/original.jpeg") - Original media URL before any processing (watermarking/optimization). Set automatically by the system.
  - watermarkedUrl string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/test/media/watermarked.jpeg") - URL of the media after watermarking. Set automatically when watermark is applied.
  - type* string (enum: image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/png | image/gif | video/mp4 | video/mov | video/webm; e.g. "image/jpeg") - MIME type of the media file. See Platform Limitations Guide for platform-specific format support.
  - thumbnail string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/test/media/test.jpeg") - Cover image URL for a video media item. **Scope** - Applies to the **first video** in `media[]`. Values supplied on subsequent video items are ignored. - Has no effect on image-only media items. **Response behavior** - After the post is published, the resolved cover image is surfaced on the post-level `thumbnail` field of the response and is no longer echoed back inside `media[]`. This represents the post's primary cover image and the cover used for the first video. **Limitations** - Per-item thumbnails for multi-video posts are not supported. Each destination network exposes a single cover image per post for the leading video; this matches the behavior of the underlying social platform APIs. **Format** - Provide a publicly accessible JPEG or PNG URL. Animated formats and video URLs are not accepted. - Recommended: an image matching the orientation of your video and ≤ 2 MB.
  - defaultThumb string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/test/test/media/default-thumb.jpeg") - Default thumbnail URL, auto-generated from video if not provided.
  - id string (e.g. "media_abc123xyz") - Unique identifier for the media item. Used for tracking and referencing.
  - optimizedUrl string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/your-bucket/media/optimized-image.jpg") - URL of the optimized/compressed media. Set automatically when media optimization is enabled. **Enable Optimization:** Set `mediaOptimization: true` in the post request.
  - optimizedType string (e.g. "image/jpeg") - MIME type of the optimized media. May differ from original if format conversion occurred.
  - isModified boolean - Flag indicating if the media was modified (watermarked, optimized, or processed).
  - altText string (e.g. "A sunset over the ocean with silhouetted palm trees") - Alt text for accessibility. Supported on Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and LinkedIn image posts (ignored for video and other platforms). Auto-truncated per platform: Pinterest 500, Instagram/Threads 1000, Bluesky 2000, LinkedIn 4086 chars.
- status string (enum: draft | scheduled | in_review | published | in_progress | pending | failed | notification_sent | deleted; e.g. "draft") - Post status indicating the current state of the post. **Available Status Values:** - `draft` - Post saved as draft, not yet ready for publishing - `scheduled` - Post scheduled for future publishing (requires `scheduleDate`) - `in_review` - Post pending approval (requires `scheduleDate` and `postApprovalDetails`) - `published` - Post has been published - `in_progress` - Post is currently being processed - `pending` - Post is awaiting platform processing for Instagram media container creation - `failed` - Post publishing failed - `notification_sent` - Story notification sent (for manual story posting) - `deleted` - Post has been deleted **Validations:** - `scheduled` or `in_review` status requires `scheduleDate` to be set - Submitting for review (`in_review`) requires `postApprovalDetails.approver`; approve/reject actions reuse the stored approver - Draft posts skip most validations (accountIds, media requirements)
- scheduleDate string (e.g. "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z") - Schedule Date. Required when `status` is `scheduled` or `in_review`.
- selectedBestTime string (e.g. "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z") - Selected Best Time slot for scheduling
- createdBy string (e.g. "65f151c99bc2bf3aaf970d72") - User ID of the creator who is creating/managing the post. Must be a valid 24-character hex ID. **Get User IDs from:** [Get User API](/users/{userId}) — use the `id` field from the user object. **Validation:** Must be a valid 24-character hex ID.
- followUpComment string (e.g. "What do you think? Let us know in the comments!") - Follow-up comment to be posted immediately after the main post is published. **Supported Platforms:** Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Community, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube, TikTok **NOT Supported:** GBP (Google Business Profile), Pinterest - TikTok: posted once the video becomes publicly viewable (~1-3 min), not instantly - TikTok: only public videos support a follow-up comment. Set `privacyLevel` to `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` — friends-only and private videos are not supported **Use Case:** Great for adding hashtags, additional context, or engagement prompts without cluttering the main post. - Like `summary`, the follow-up comment is trimmed to the **strictest** limit among the post's platforms, not to each platform's own limit — a post that includes Bluesky (300) trims the comment to 300 everywhere. Send one request per platform to keep the full comment on each. **Reference:** [Platform Limitations Guide](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/48001240003-social-planner-image-video-content-and-api-limitations)
- ogTagsDetails object - Og Tags Meta Data
  - metaImage string (e.g. "https://yoursite.com/images/og-image.jpg") - Preview image URL for the shared link. **Best Practices:** - Use high-quality images (1200x630px recommended) - Ensure the image is publicly accessible **Auto-fetch:** Use the Get Metatags API to fetch OG data from a URL.
  - metaLink string (e.g. "https://yoursite.com/blog/amazing-article") - URL of the webpage being shared. This is the destination when users click the link preview.
  - ogTitle string (e.g. "How to Double Your Social Media Engagement") - Custom title for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:title meta tag. **Tip:** Keep titles concise (50-60 characters) for best display across platforms.
  - ogDescription string (e.g. "Learn proven strategies to boost your social media engagement and grow your audience.") - Custom description for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:description meta tag. **Tip:** Keep descriptions under 155 characters for optimal display.
- type* string (enum: post | story | reel; e.g. "post") - Type of post to create. Determines the format and platform requirements. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (all platforms) - `story` - Temporary 24-hour story (Instagram, Facebook) - `reel` - Short-form video content (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube) **Customize Per Platform:** You can specify different content/types per platform using `facebookPostDetails.type`, `instagramPostDetails.type`, etc. **Validations:** - Reels require exactly 1 video - Stories: Caption not supported for Instagram/Facebook - Facebook Groups do not support Reels
- postApprovalDetails object - Post Approval Details
  - approver string (e.g. "iVrVJ2uoXNF0wzcBzgl5") - User ID of the designated approver. **Note:** The approver will receive a notification when a post is submitted for review.
  - requesterNote string (e.g. "Please review the messaging for our Q4 campaign launch. Let me know if the CTA needs adjustment.") - Note from the post creator to the approver explaining the post or requesting specific feedback.
  - approverNote string (e.g. "Approved! Great content. Consider adding more hashtags for visibility.") - Note from the approver to the post creator with feedback or approval comments.
  - approvalStatus string (enum: pending | approved | rejected | not_required; e.g. "pending") - Current approval status of the post. **Available Values:** - `pending` - Awaiting approver review - `approved` - Approved and ready for publishing - `rejected` - Rejected by approver (needs revision) - `not_required` - No approval workflow needed
- scheduleTimeUpdated boolean - Flag indicating if the schedule datetime was manually updated. Used for tracking rescheduled posts.
- tags string[] (e.g. ["65f151c99bc2bf3aaf970d72","65f151c99bc2bf3aaf970d73"]) - Array of Tag IDs to associate with the post for organization and filtering. **Get Tag IDs from:** [Get Tags API](/social-media-posting/{locationId}/tags) — use the `_id` field from each tag. **Validation:** All IDs must be valid 24-character hex IDs.
- categoryId string (e.g. "65f151c99bc2bf3aaf970d72") - Category ID to organize the post. Categories help group related posts. **Get Category IDs from:** [Get Categories API](/social-media-posting/{locationId}/categories) — use the `_id` field. **Validation:** Must be a valid 24-character hex ID.
- applyWatermark boolean - Apply watermark to media in this post. **Note:** Watermarks are applied to images only. Videos are not watermarked.
- tiktokPostDetails object - Tiktok Post Details
  - privacyLevel string (enum: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | SELF_ONLY; e.g. "PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE") - Privacy level controlling who can view the video. **Available Values:** - `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` - Anyone can view (default) - `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS` - Only mutual followers can view - `SELF_ONLY` - Only you can view (private) **Note:** If set to `SELF_ONLY`, `videoDisclosure` must be `false`.
  - promoteOtherBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes a third-party brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting another brand.
  - enableComment boolean - Allow users to comment on the video. Default is determined by account settings.
  - enableDuet boolean - Allow users to create Duet videos with your content. **Duet:** Side-by-side video featuring your content and the creator's reaction/addition.
  - enableStitch boolean - Allow users to create Stitch videos with your content. **Stitch:** Clips up to 5 seconds of your video that creators can use in their own videos.
  - videoDisclosure boolean - Enable branded content disclosure. Required when video is promotional content. **Validations:** - Cannot be `true` if `privacyLevel` is `SELF_ONLY` - If enabled, at least one of `promoteYourBrand` or `promoteOtherBrand` must be `true`
  - promoteYourBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes your own brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting your own brand.
- gmbPostDetails object - GMB Post Details
  - gmbEventType* string (enum: STANDARD | EVENT | OFFER; e.g. "STANDARD") - Google My Business post type. **Available Types:** - `STANDARD` - Regular update post (What's New) - `EVENT` - Event announcement with dates and title - `OFFER` - Promotional offer with coupon and redemption details **Required fields by type:** - STANDARD: None additional - EVENT: `title`, `startDate`, `endDate` - OFFER: `offerTitle`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `termsConditions`, `couponCode`, `redeemOnlineUrl`
  - title string (e.g. "Summer Sale Event 2024") - Event title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `EVENT`. **Max length:** 58 characters
  - offerTitle string (e.g. "50% Off All Products") - Offer title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `OFFER`.
  - startDate object - Start date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Structure:** - `startDate`: { year, month, day } - `startTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
    - startDate object - Start Date
      - year* number (e.g. 2022) - Year component of the date
      - month* number (e.g. 1) - Month component of the date (1-12)
      - day* number (e.g. 1) - Day component of the date (1-31)
    - startTime object - Start Time
      - hours* number (e.g. 23) - Hour component of the time (0-23)
      - minutes* number (e.g. 56) - Minute component of the time (0-59)
      - seconds* number (e.g. 34) - Second component of the time (0-59)
  - endDate object - End date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Validation:** Must be after `startDate`. **Structure:** - `endDate`: { year, month, day } - `endTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
    - endDate object - End Date
      - year* number (e.g. 2022) - Year component of the date
      - month* number (e.g. 1) - Month component of the date (1-12)
      - day* number (e.g. 1) - Day component of the date (1-31)
    - endTime object - End Time
      - hours* number (e.g. 23) - Hour component of the time (0-23)
      - minutes* number (e.g. 56) - Minute component of the time (0-59)
      - seconds* number (e.g. 34) - Second component of the time (0-59)
  - termsConditions string (e.g. "https://yoursite.com/terms-and-conditions") - URL to terms and conditions page. Required for OFFER posts.
  - url string (e.g. "https://yoursite.com/book-now") - Call-to-action URL. Required when `actionType` is set (except `none` and `call`). **Required for:** STANDARD and EVENT posts with actionType other than `none` or `call`.
  - couponCode string (e.g. "SAVE50") - Promotional coupon code. Required for OFFER posts.
  - redeemOnlineUrl string (e.g. "https://yoursite.com/redeem-offer") - URL where customers can redeem the offer online. Required for OFFER posts.
  - actionType string (enum: none | order | book | shop | learn_more | call | sign_up; e.g. "book") - Call-to-action button type for the post. **Available Actions:** - `none` - No action button - `order` - Order online - `book` - Book appointment - `shop` - Shop now - `learn_more` - Learn more - `call` - Call now (no URL required) - `sign_up` - Sign up **Note:** All actions except `none` and `call` require a `url`.
- userId string (e.g. "sdfdsfdsfEWEsdfsdsW32dd") - User ID of the user creating/managing the post. Required for OAuth channel posts (non-draft).
- linkedinPostDetails object - LinkedIn-specific post configuration. **Key Fields:** - `postAsPdf`: Set to `true` to post images as a PDF carousel document - `pdfTitle`: Title for the PDF document (max 100 characters) **Limits:** - Max 9 images/videos for regular posts - Max 300 pages for PDF carousel - Max PDF size: 100 MB **Reference:** [Platform Limitations Guide](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/48001240003-social-planner-image-video-content-and-api-limitations)
  - pdfTitle string (e.g. "Q4 Marketing Strategy Presentation") - Title for the PDF document carousel. Displayed as the document name on LinkedIn. **Max length:** 100 characters **Tip:** Use a descriptive title that explains the document content.
  - postAsPdf boolean - Post images as a PDF document carousel. **Limits:** - Max 300 pages/images - Max PDF size: 100 MB
  - poll object - Publish a LinkedIn poll post. **Required fields when `poll` is supplied:** - `question` (max 140 characters) - `options`: 2 to 4 entries, each `text` ≤ 30 characters; option texts must be unique - `settings.duration`: one of `ONE_DAY`, `THREE_DAYS`, `SEVEN_DAYS`, `FOURTEEN_DAYS` **LinkedIn restrictions:** - Polls cannot be edited after publishing. - A poll post cannot include `media` or a meta-link preview.
    - question* string (maxLength: 140; e.g. "What is your favorite color?") - Question for the poll. Max length: 140 characters.
    - options* object[] (minItems: 2; maxItems: 4) - Poll options. Minimum 2, maximum 4. Each option text max 30 characters. Option texts must be unique.
      - text* string (maxLength: 30; e.g. "Red") - Text describing the option. Max length: 30 characters.
    - settings* object - Poll settings (duration).
      - duration* string (enum: ONE_DAY | THREE_DAYS | SEVEN_DAYS | FOURTEEN_DAYS; e.g. "SEVEN_DAYS") - Duration the poll stays open for votes.
- pinterestPostDetails object - Pinterest-specific post configuration. Required when posting to Pinterest accounts. **Required Fields:** - `boardIds`: Object mapping account OAuth IDs to Pinterest board IDs **Optional Fields:** - `title`: Pin title (max 100 characters) - `link`: Destination URL for the pin (max 2048 characters) **Get Board IDs:** Use the Pinterest boards API or retrieve from connected account details. **Limits:** - Max 1 image/video per pin - Caption max 800 characters **Reference:** [Platform Limitations Guide](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/48001240003-social-planner-image-video-content-and-api-limitations)
  - title string (e.g. "10 Easy Home Decor Ideas for 2024") - Pin title displayed on Pinterest. **Max length:** 100 characters **Best Practices:** - Include relevant keywords - Be descriptive and engaging
  - link string (e.g. "https://yoursite.com/blog/home-decor-ideas") - Destination URL for the pin. Users clicking the pin will be directed to this URL. **Max length:** 2048 characters **Best Practices:** - Use direct links to relevant content - Track with UTM parameters for analytics
  - boardIds map<string, string> (deprecated) - **DEPRECATED — use `pinterestBoards` instead.** Will be removed on July 31, 2026. Legacy mapping of Pinterest account OAuth IDs to a single board ID: `{ accountOAuthId: "boardId" }` For multi-board posting, use `pinterestBoards`.
  - pinterestBoards object[] - Per-account Pinterest board selection. Each entry binds one connected Pinterest account to a list of boards on that account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account. When supplied, this field takes precedence over the deprecated `boardIds` field.
    - accountId* string (e.g. "6887d6de1d8175813d50dab8") - Connected Pinterest account ID. Must match one of the accounts referenced in the post's `userIds`.
    - boards* string[] (e.g. ["987654321098765432","234567890123456789"]) - Pinterest board IDs to publish to on this account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account.
  - shortenedLinks string[] - Shortened links for the post (auto-generated).
- facebookPostDetails object - Facebook-specific post configuration. **Key Fields:** - `type`: Post type (`post`, `story`, `reel`) **Restrictions:** - Facebook Groups do NOT support Reels - Reels require exactly 1 video - Stories do not support captions **Reference:** [Platform Limitations Guide](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/48001240003-social-planner-image-video-content-and-api-limitations)
  - type* string (enum: post | story | reel; e.g. "post") - Facebook post format type. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, text) - `story` - 24-hour temporary story - `reel` - Short-form vertical video **Restrictions:** - Reels: Require exactly 1 video, not supported on Groups - Stories: Captions not supported
  - textFormatPresetId string (e.g. "303063890126415") - Facebook background preset ID for text-only feed posts. **Facebook `post` only** — not `story` or `reel`. Ignored when media is attached; `metaLink` is omitted on publish. **Validations** — request returns `400` if violated: - Must be a valid preset ID from the [Facebook text background preset reference](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008005-facebook-text-background-posts-preset-reference). Empty strings, whitespace-only values, and `null` are rejected. - When set, `summary` must be 130 characters or fewer.
- instagramPostDetails object - Instagram-specific post configuration. **Key Fields:** - `type`: Post type (`post`, `story`, `reel`) - `collaborators`: Map of account IDs to Instagram usernames for collaboration invites (max 5 per account) - `showOnFeed`: Show reel on profile feed (for reels) **Collaborators Structure:** ```json { "accountId": ["username1", "username2"] } ``` Where `accountId` is from [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) and usernames are Instagram handles without @. **Restrictions:** - Media is REQUIRED for all Instagram posts - Max 30 hashtags allowed in caption - Stories do not support captions - Collaborators: Posts/Reels only (NOT Stories) - Reels require exactly 1 video **Reference:** [Platform Limitations Guide](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/48001240003-social-planner-image-video-content-and-api-limitations)
  - type* string (enum: post | story | reel; e.g. "post") - Instagram post format type. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, carousels) - `story` - 24-hour temporary story - `reel` - Short-form vertical video (up to 90 seconds) **Restrictions:** - Media is REQUIRED for all Instagram posts - Reels: Require exactly 1 video - Stories: Captions not supported, JPEG only for images
  - collaborators object - Collaboration invites mapping account IDs to Instagram usernames. **Structure:** `{ accountId: [username1, username2, username3] }` - **Key:** Account ID from `accountIds` array (the Instagram account posting) - **Value:** Array of Instagram usernames to invite as collaborators **Get Account IDs from:** [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) — use the `id` field from Instagram accounts. **✅ Supported for:** Posts and Reels only (NOT Stories) **Validations:** - Maximum 5 collaborators per account - No duplicate usernames allowed - Usernames are Instagram handles without @ **Use Case:** Invite other Instagram users to collaborate. Once accepted, the post appears on both profiles.
  - publishViaPushNotification boolean - Send Instagram Story via Push Notification instead of direct posting. Only applicable for Story type.
  - publisherNote string - Note to the publisher for manual posting guidance. Only used when publishViaPushNotification is true.
  - notificationSentCount number (e.g. 1) - Number of push notifications sent for this Instagram Story. Tracks how many notifications have been sent out.
  - postedVia string (enum: web | mobile; e.g. "web") - Source of where the post was marked as published. Values: "web" (web interface), "mobile" (mobile app), or null.
  - showOnFeed boolean - Show Reel on profile grid/feed. **✅ Applies to:** Reels only - `true` - Reel appears on your profile grid - `false` - Reel only appears in Reels tab
- youtubePostDetails object - YouTube-specific post configuration. **Key Fields:** - `title`: Video title (max 100 characters) - `type`: Video type (`video` for regular videos, `short` for YouTube Shorts) - `privacyLevel`: Video visibility (`private`, `public`, `unlisted`) **Limits:** - Max 1 video per post - Caption (description) max 5,000 characters **Requirements:** - Video is REQUIRED for YouTube posts - `type` field is required
  - title string (e.g. "How to Build a Successful Marketing Strategy in 2024") - Video title displayed on YouTube. **Max length:** 100 characters **Best Practices:** - Include relevant keywords - Be descriptive but concise - Avoid clickbait
  - privacyLevel string (enum: private | public | unlisted; e.g. "public") - Video visibility/privacy setting. **Available Values:** - `public` - Anyone can search and view - `unlisted` - Only people with the link can view - `private` - Only you can view
  - type* string (enum: video | short; e.g. "video") - YouTube video format type. **Available Types:** - `video` - Standard YouTube video (landscape, any duration) - `short` - YouTube Shorts (vertical, up to 60 seconds) **Required field.**
- communityPostDetails object - Community-specific post configuration for Communities. **Required Fields:** - `title`: Post title (max 1,000 characters) - `postAsUser`: the member to publish as, keyed by Community account ID **Optional Fields:** - `notifyAllGroupMembers`: notify all group members (`@everyone` broadcast) **Limits:** - Max 4 media items - Caption max 100,000 characters **Required when** `accountIds` contains a Community account and the post is not a draft.
  - title* string (e.g. "Welcome to Our New Community Feature!") - Title of the community post. Displayed as the post headline. **Max length:** 1,000 characters **Required:** Yes, for all Community posts.
  - notifyAllGroupMembers boolean - Notify every member of the group when the post is published, equivalent to an `@everyone` broadcast prepended to the post content. **Use Case:** Enable for announcements that all members should see. **Default:** `false`
  - postAsUser* object - The Community member each post is published as, keyed by Community account ID. **Structure:** `{ accountId: { id, name, avatar } }` - **Key** — the Community account ID. This is the same value you pass in `accountIds`: take it from the `id` field of a Community account in the Get Accounts API, not the `oauthId` field. - `id` (required) — `contactId` of the member to publish as, from the Get Community Members API. - `name` (optional) — display name shown as the post author. - `avatar` (optional) — profile image URL shown against the post. **Required:** Yes. Every Community account listed in `accountIds` must have an entry here, otherwise the request is rejected. **Member eligibility:** the member must be an active member of the group and hold a role in it. This is checked again at publish time, so a member who leaves the group or loses access between scheduling and publishing causes that post to fail. Use the Validate Community Member API to confirm a stored member is still eligible before scheduling. **Private channels:** list members per account rather than reusing one list across accounts — for a private channel only that channel's members may be posted as.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- message* string - Message
- results object - Requested Results
  - post object - Post Data
    - _id string - Unique identifier of the post
    - source string (enum: composer | csv | recurring | review | rss | template-library | category-queue | native) - source must be one of the following values: composer, recurring, csv
    - locationId* string - Location Id
    - platform string - platform must be one of the following values: google, facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, tiktok
    - displayDate string (format: date-time) - Display date for the post
    - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was created
    - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was last updated
    - accountId string - Account Id
    - error* string - Error
    - postId string - Platform-specific post identifier
    - previewLink string - Direct link to view the published post on the native platform. Populated once the post is published on a platform that returns a permalink; `null` for posts that are not yet published (draft, scheduled, failed) or on platforms that do not return a link.
    - insights object - Aggregated engagement metrics for the published post. Populated asynchronously by the insights sync workers for supported platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube). Absent on posts that have not been synced yet or on platforms where insights are not supported.
      - like number - Number of likes on the published post
      - share number - Number of shares of the published post
      - comment number - Number of comments on the published post
    - publishedAt string - Date when the post was published
    - thumbnail string - Post-level cover image (thumbnail) URL. For posts that contain a video, this is the resolved cover image used for the first video in `media[]`. It is set automatically from the `thumbnail` provided on the first video media item at create/edit time, or auto-generated from the video when one is not supplied. Per-item thumbnails inside `media[]` are not retained on the response — the primary cover image lives on this field.
    - accountIds string[] - Account Ids
    - summary string - Content text of the post
    - media object[] - Post Media Data The limitations of media as per the platforms is provided through the reference link in API description
      - url* string - Public URL of the media file. Must be a valid, accessible HTTPS URL.
      - caption string - Alt text or caption for the media. Used for accessibility and SEO.
      - originalUrl string - Original media URL before any processing (watermarking/optimization). Set automatically by the system.
      - watermarkedUrl string - URL of the media after watermarking. Set automatically when watermark is applied.
      - type* string (enum: image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/png | image/gif | video/mp4 | video/mov | video/webm) - MIME type of the media file. See Platform Limitations Guide for platform-specific format support.
      - thumbnail string - Cover image URL for a video media item. **Scope** - Applies to the **first video** in `media[]`. Values supplied on subsequent video items are ignored. - Has no effect on image-only media items. **Response behavior** - After the post is published, the resolved cover image is surfaced on the post-level `thumbnail` field of the response and is no longer echoed back inside `media[]`. This represents the post's primary cover image and the cover used for the first video. **Limitations** - Per-item thumbnails for multi-video posts are not supported. Each destination network exposes a single cover image per post for the leading video; this matches the behavior of the underlying social platform APIs. **Format** - Provide a publicly accessible JPEG or PNG URL. Animated formats and video URLs are not accepted. - Recommended: an image matching the orientation of your video and ≤ 2 MB.
      - defaultThumb string - Default thumbnail URL, auto-generated from video if not provided.
      - id string - Unique identifier for the media item. Used for tracking and referencing.
      - optimizedUrl string - URL of the optimized/compressed media. Set automatically when media optimization is enabled. **Enable Optimization:** Set `mediaOptimization: true` in the post request.
      - optimizedType string - MIME type of the optimized media. May differ from original if format conversion occurred.
      - isModified boolean - Flag indicating if the media was modified (watermarked, optimized, or processed).
      - altText string - Alt text for accessibility. Supported on Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and LinkedIn image posts (ignored for video and other platforms). Auto-truncated per platform: Pinterest 500, Instagram/Threads 1000, Bluesky 2000, LinkedIn 4086 chars.
    - status string (enum: in_progress | draft | failed | published | scheduled | in_review | notification_sent | pending | deleted) - Status must be one of the following values: in_progress, draft, failed, published, scheduled, in_review, notification_sent, pending, deleted
    - createdBy string - User ID who created the post
    - type* string (enum: post | story | reel | short) - Post Type must be one of the following values: post, story, reel, short
    - tags string[] - Tag Ids
    - ogTagsDetails object - Og Tags Meta Data
      - metaImage string - Preview image URL for the shared link. **Best Practices:** - Use high-quality images (1200x630px recommended) - Ensure the image is publicly accessible **Auto-fetch:** Use the Get Metatags API to fetch OG data from a URL.
      - metaLink string - URL of the webpage being shared. This is the destination when users click the link preview.
      - ogTitle string - Custom title for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:title meta tag. **Tip:** Keep titles concise (50-60 characters) for best display across platforms.
      - ogDescription string - Custom description for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:description meta tag. **Tip:** Keep descriptions under 155 characters for optimal display.
    - postApprovalDetails object - Post Approval Details
      - approver string - User ID of the designated approver. **Note:** The approver will receive a notification when a post is submitted for review.
      - requesterNote string - Note from the post creator to the approver explaining the post or requesting specific feedback.
      - approverNote string - Note from the approver to the post creator with feedback or approval comments.
      - approvalStatus string (enum: pending | approved | rejected | not_required) - Current approval status of the post. **Available Values:** - `pending` - Awaiting approver review - `approved` - Approved and ready for publishing - `rejected` - Rejected by approver (needs revision) - `not_required` - No approval workflow needed
      - approverUser object - Approver User Details
        - id* string - User Id
        - title* string - Title
        - firstName* string - First name
        - lastName* string - Last name
        - profilePhoto* string - Profile photo
        - phone* string - Phone number
        - email* string - Email Id
    - tiktokPostDetails object - Tiktok Post Details
      - privacyLevel string (enum: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | SELF_ONLY) - Privacy level controlling who can view the video. **Available Values:** - `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` - Anyone can view (default) - `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS` - Only mutual followers can view - `SELF_ONLY` - Only you can view (private) **Note:** If set to `SELF_ONLY`, `videoDisclosure` must be `false`.
      - promoteOtherBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes a third-party brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting another brand.
      - enableComment boolean - Allow users to comment on the video. Default is determined by account settings.
      - enableDuet boolean - Allow users to create Duet videos with your content. **Duet:** Side-by-side video featuring your content and the creator's reaction/addition.
