### Get Available Accounts (Step 2 of 3)
GET /social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/{platform}/accounts/{accountId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/{platform}/accounts/{accountId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-oauth-accounts | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-oauth-accounts.md

Scheduled for removal in a future version.

**OAuth Connection Flow - Step 2: Get Available Accounts**

After completing OAuth authentication (Step 1), use this endpoint to retrieve the list of available pages, channels, or locations that can be connected.

**OAuth Flow Position**

1. **Start OAuth** → User authenticates, returns `accountId`
2. **Get Accounts** (this endpoint) → Lists available pages/channels to connect
3. **Attach Account** → Connect the selected account

**What This Returns**

The response varies by platform:

| Platform | Returns |
|----------|--------|
| **facebook** | List of Facebook Pages the user manages |
| **instagram** | List of Instagram Professional Accounts (linked to Facebook Pages) |
| **google** | Google Business Profile locations |
| **linkedin** | LinkedIn Pages and Profile |
| **tiktok** | TikTok Creator account info |
| **tiktok-business** | TikTok Business Center accounts |
| **youtube** | YouTube Channels |
| **pinterest** | Pinterest Business accounts and boards |
| **threads** | Threads profiles |

**Next Step**

From the response, select the account/page you want to connect and use its details in Step 3:
```
POST /social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/{platform}/accounts/{accountId}
```

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/oauth.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- platform* string (enum: google | facebook | instagram | threads | bluesky | linkedin | tiktok | tiktok-business | youtube | pinterest; e.g. "facebook") - Social media platform. Must match the platform used in the preceding steps of the OAuth flow.
- locationId* string (e.g. "w37swmmLbA02zgqKPpxITe2") - The Location ID where you want to connect this social account
- accountId* string (e.g. "w37swmmLbA02zgqKPpxITe") - The OAuth Account ID received from Step 1 (Start OAuth) via the window message event

Query parameters:
- search string (e.g. "page name") - Search term to filter accounts/pages by name. Useful when the user has many pages to choose from.

Response 200 (Returns available accounts/pages/channels that can be connected. Response structure varies by platform - see examples below.) application/json:
- (root) object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object
  - option 1 Facebook: object
    - success* boolean - Whether the page lookup completed without an upstream API error
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The Facebook Pages available to connect. See `GetFacebookAccountsSchema` for the full field breakdown.
      - pages object[] - Facebook Pages the authenticated user manages and either owns or can post to (`CREATE_CONTENT` task). Always an array — empty when the user has no eligible pages, or when the lookup failed (see `success`/`error` below). Optionally filtered by the `search` query parameter on the request.
        - id string - Facebook page identifier
        - name string - Name of the Facebook page
        - avatar string - Page picture URL from Facebook's `picture` field; absent if Facebook did not return one.
        - isOwned boolean - Facebook's `is_owned` flag — true when the authenticated user is the Business Manager owner of this page, as opposed to only having a task-based role on it.
        - isConnected boolean - True when this page's ID is already among the location's connected Facebook accounts — computed by this API, not returned by Facebook.
        - isCreatorTask boolean - True when the authenticated user has the `CREATE_CONTENT` task permission on this page. Only present when this list was served from the background-fetched page cache rather than fetched live; absent otherwise.
      - success boolean - False when the Facebook Graph API call failed; omitted entirely on a successful call. The response envelope's top-level `success` is also set to false in that case.
      - error object - Populated only when `success` is false — a generic, retry-safe error summary (never the raw upstream Facebook error). `code` is always `FACEBOOK_API_ERROR`.
  - option 2 Tiktok Business: object
    - success* boolean - Success or Failure
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The TikTok account available to connect for this OAuth account. Used for both the tiktok and tiktok-business platforms — both route through the same TikTok Business API lookup.
      - profile object[] - The TikTok account available to connect. A single-element array — TikTok OAuth authenticates exactly one account per connection, whether it is a personal creator account (tiktok) or a Business Center account (tiktok-business). Empty array when the profile could not be fetched.
        - id string - The TikTok user's open_id, scoped to this app. Send this value back as originId when calling Attach Account.
        - name string - Display name of the TikTok account.
        - username string - @handle of the TikTok account.
        - avatar string - URL of the account's profile image, as returned by TikTok.
        - verified boolean - True when TikTok has verified the account. For a profile (personal creator) account this reflects the caller's own longUploadsStatus; for a business account it is only filled in once the profile is matched to an already-connected account, so it can be absent on a first-time business connect.
        - isConnected boolean - True when this profile is already attached to the location as a connected account.
        - type string (enum: profile | business) - 'profile' for a personal TikTok creator login (tiktok platform) or 'business' for a TikTok Business Center login (tiktok-business platform).
        - isBusinessAccount boolean - True when this profile was fetched through the TikTok Business API (a tiktok-business connect). Not present on profiles returned for the personal tiktok platform.
  - option 3 Google Business Account: object
    - success* boolean - Whether the location lookup completed without an upstream API error
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The Business Profile locations available to connect, plus reconnect/error context when applicable. See `GetGoogleLocationAccountSchema` for the full field breakdown.
      - locations object[] - Every Business Profile location the authenticated Google user can manage, each paired with the account that owns it. Always an array — empty when the user has no locations, or when the lookup failed (see `success`/`error` below). Pick one entry and send its `location`/`account` pair as the Attach Account (Step 3) request body.
        - location object - The Business Profile location for this entry in the `locations` array.
          - name string - Business Profile location resource name, in the form `locations/{locationId}`. Pass it back as `location.name` in the Attach Account (Step 3) request body to connect this location.
          - storeCode string - Merchant-assigned store code for this location, if one was set on Google Business Profile.
          - title string - Business location title or name
          - metadata object - Google-controlled attributes for this location as returned by the Business Profile API — e.g. `placeId` once Google has mapped the listing (used to compute `isVerified` below). Not editable by the caller.
          - storefrontAddress object - Postal address of the location as returned by Google (address lines, locality, region code, etc.).
          - relationshipData object - Google-reported relationships for this location, including `childrenLocations` when it is the parent of a multi-location chain. `maxLocation` below is derived from this.
          - maxLocation boolean - True when this location has 10 or more child locations listed in `relationshipData` (i.e. it heads a large chain). Computed from `relationshipData.childrenLocations.length`; Google does not return this flag directly.
          - isVerified boolean - True when Google has assigned this location a Place ID (`metadata.placeId`), meaning the listing is mapped and verified on Google Maps; false if unverified.
          - isConnected boolean - True when this location is already connected to the location making the request, determined by matching this location's ID against already-connected accounts — not a value Google returns.
        - account object - The Business Profile account that owns the location above, paired with it for this entry.
          - name string - Business Profile account resource name, in the form `accounts/{accountId}`. Returned as-is from Google's Accounts API alongside each location; pass it back as `account.name` in the Attach Account (Step 3) request body.
          - accountName string - Display name of the Google Business account
          - type string - Google account type, e.g. `PERSONAL`, `LOCATION_GROUP` or `ORGANIZATION`. Passed through from Google's API unmodified.
          - verificationState string - Google's verification state for the account, e.g. `VERIFIED` or `UNVERIFIED`.
          - vettedState string - Google's vetting state for the account, e.g. `VETTED` or `NOT_VETTED`.
      - reconnectDetails string[] - Only present when this response came from the "get locations by request id" polling flow (not the direct Get Accounts call). One entry per previously-connected location that needed re-authentication during the OAuth callback: `isConnected: true` if this login restored access automatically, or `error`/`helpMessage`/`helpUrl` if the user still lacks permission to that location and must pick a different one. Each entry also carries the location's native Google `originId`, which this shared reconnect schema does not list; note `error` is set as the literal boolean `true` on this platform, not a message string.
      - accountId string - 24-character hex identifier of the OAuth connection record this poll is for. Only present when this response came from the "get locations by request id" flow; echoes the `accountId` delivered by Start OAuth.
      - account object (nullable) - Always null. Present only when the Business Profile lookup failed (see `success`/`error` below); kept so the response shape stays consistent for callers even on failure.
      - success boolean - False when the Google Business Profile lookup failed; omitted entirely on a successful call. The response envelope's top-level `success` is also set to false in that case.
      - error object - Populated only when `success` is false — a generic, retry-safe error summary (never the raw upstream Google error). `code` is always `GOOGLE_API_ERROR`.
  - option 4 Linkedin: object
    - success* boolean - Success or Failure
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - LinkedIn pages and member profile available to connect for this OAuth account.
      - pages object[] - LinkedIn Pages the authenticated user administers. Always an array — empty when the user has no admin-level page access.
        - id string - Numeric LinkedIn organization ID for the page (the suffix of its urn). Send this value back as originId when calling Attach Account.
        - name string - Display name of the LinkedIn Page, as returned by the LinkedIn API.
        - avatar string - URL of the page's logo image. Empty string when LinkedIn has no logo on file.
        - urn string - LinkedIn URN identifying the organization. Send this value back as urn when calling Attach Account.
        - isConnected boolean - True when this page is already attached to the location as a connected account.
      - profile object[] - The authenticated LinkedIn member. Always a single-element array — LinkedIn OAuth authenticates exactly one member per connection, and there is no way to list other members.
        - id string - Numeric LinkedIn member ID for the authenticated user (the suffix of their urn).
        - name string - Full name of the authenticated LinkedIn member.
        - avatar string - URL of the member's LinkedIn profile picture. Empty string when none is set.
        - urn string - LinkedIn URN identifying the member. Send this value back as urn when calling Attach Account.
        - isConnected boolean - True when this profile is already attached to the location as a connected account.
      - reconnectDetails string[] - Only populated when this schema is returned by the request-id polling endpoint (GET /oauth/linkedin/accounts) during a reconnect, never by the Get Accounts step. Lists the location's previously-connected pages/profiles: an entry with isConnected: true was reactivated under the freshly-authenticated user's token, while an entry carrying error/helpMessage belongs to a different LinkedIn user and still needs its original owner to reconnect.
      - accountId string - Local OAuth record ID for the connection that was just completed or reconnected. Only populated by the request-id polling endpoint (GET /oauth/linkedin/accounts), never by the Get Accounts step.
  - option 5 Instagram: object
    - success* boolean - Whether the account lookup completed without an upstream API error
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The Instagram Professional accounts available to connect, plus reconnect/error context when applicable. See `GetInstagramAccountsSchema` for the full field breakdown.
      - accounts object[] - Instagram Professional (Business/Creator) accounts the authenticated user can post to. Always an array — empty when the user has no eligible accounts, or when the lookup failed (see `success`/`error` below). Optionally filtered by the `search` query parameter on the request.
        - id string - Instagram-scoped user ID — the Instagram Business/Creator account's own ID when linked through a Facebook Page, or the account's `user_id` when connected via direct Instagram login.
        - name string - Instagram username of the account
        - avatar string - Profile picture URL from Instagram's `profile_picture_url` field.
        - pageId string - ID of the Facebook Page this Instagram account is linked to. Only present when the account was discovered through the Facebook-login flow; absent for accounts connected via direct Instagram login.
        - isConnected boolean - True when this account's ID is already among the location's connected Instagram accounts — computed by this API, not returned by Instagram.
      - reconnectDetails string[] - Only present when this response came from the "get accounts by request id" polling flow (not the direct Get Accounts call). One entry per previously-connected Instagram account that needed re-authentication during the OAuth callback: `isConnected: true` if this login restored access automatically, or `error`/`helpMessage`/`helpUrl` if the account is still not linked to a Page the user manages (or, for direct Instagram login, no longer owned by the user). Each entry also carries the account's native `originId`, which this shared reconnect schema does not list; note `error` is set as the literal boolean `true` on this platform, not a message string.
      - accountId string (nullable) - 24-character hex identifier of the OAuth connection record this poll is for. Only present when this response came from the "get accounts by request id" flow; echoes the `accountId` delivered by Start OAuth. Null if that flow itself failed.
      - success boolean - False when the Instagram/Facebook Graph API call failed; omitted entirely on a successful call. The response envelope's top-level `success` is also set to false in that case.
      - error object - Populated only when `success` is false — a generic, retry-safe error summary (never the raw upstream error). `code` is always `INSTAGRAM_API_ERROR`.
  - option 6 Threads: object
    - success* boolean - Success or Failure
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The Threads profile available to connect.
      - profile object[] - Threads Profile Details
        - id string - ID of profile
        - name string - Name of profile
        - avatar string - Avatar of profile
        - username string - Username of profile
        - isConnected boolean - Is connected
  - option 7 YouTube: object
    - success* boolean - Success or Failure
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The YouTube channels available to connect.
      - profile object[] - YouTube channel profile details for the connected accounts
        - id string - The YouTube channel ID for the authenticated user's channel.
        - name string - Display title of the YouTube channel.
        - username string - The channel's custom URL handle, or undefined when the channel has not set one.
        - avatar string - URL of the channel's thumbnail image (medium size, falling back to default).
        - verified boolean - True when the channel is eligible for long uploads (YouTube's status.longUploadsStatus === 'allowed'). Used as a proxy for account standing — it is not a general verification badge.
        - isConnected boolean - True when this channel is already attached to the location as a connected account.
        - type string (enum: profile) - Always 'profile' — YouTube only supports connecting a channel as a personal profile account.
      - reconnectDetails string[] - Only meaningful during a reconnect (query param reconnect=true on the request-id polling call) — always empty on a plain new connect. Lists the location's previously-connected YouTube accounts under this OAuth: an entry with isConnected: true was reactivated because it belongs to the same channel owner who just re-authenticated, while an entry carrying error/helpMessage is owned by a different YouTube account and still needs its original owner to reconnect.
      - accountId string - Local OAuth record ID for the connection that was just completed or reconnected. Only populated by the request-id polling endpoint, not by the Get Accounts step.
      - _id string - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Unique identifier of the connected account record, generated when the channel is first attached. Use it as accountId in later calls such as Update Account Meta.
      - oAuthId string - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. ID of the YouTube OAuth record (the stored token pair) this account authenticates through.
      - oldId string - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Composite legacy key built as {oAuthId}_{locationId}_{originId}_{type}, kept for backward compatibility with integrations that stored this format before _id was used as the account reference.
      - locationId string - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Location the account is connected to.
      - originId string - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. YouTube channel ID this account represents — the same value sent as originId in the Attach Account request.
      - platform string (enum: google | facebook | instagram | threads | bluesky | linkedin | twitter | tiktok | youtube | pinterest | community) - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Always 'youtube' for a YouTube connected account.
      - type string (enum: page | group | profile | location | business) - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Always 'profile' — YouTube only supports connecting a channel as a personal profile account.
      - name string - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Display name of the channel, copied from the Attach Account request body.
      - avatar string - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Avatar image URL, copied from the Attach Account request body.
      - meta object - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. YouTube-specific metadata; today this is always { verified, username } copied from the Attach Account request body.
      - active boolean - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. True while the account is connected and its token is valid; false once it needs to be reconnected.
      - deleted boolean - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. True once the account has been soft-deleted (disconnected); deleted accounts are excluded from Get Accounts results.
      - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Timestamp the account was first attached.
      - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Only present in the Attach Account (POST) response. Timestamp of the most recent update to this record.
  - option 8 Bluesky: object
    - success* boolean - Success or Failure
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The Bluesky profile available to connect.
      - profile object[] - Bluesky Profile Details
        - id string - Bluesky DID (decentralized identifier) of the profile
        - name string - Name of profile
        - avatar string - Avatar of profile
        - handle string - Bluesky handle of the profile
        - displayName string - Display name of the profile
        - isConnected boolean - Is connected
  - option 9 Tiktok: object
    - success* boolean - Success or Failure
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - The TikTok account available to connect for this OAuth account. Used for both the tiktok and tiktok-business platforms — both route through the same TikTok Business API lookup.
      - profile object[] - The TikTok account available to connect. A single-element array — TikTok OAuth authenticates exactly one account per connection, whether it is a personal creator account (tiktok) or a Business Center account (tiktok-business). Empty array when the profile could not be fetched.
        - id string - The TikTok user's open_id, scoped to this app. Send this value back as originId when calling Attach Account.
        - name string - Display name of the TikTok account.
        - username string - @handle of the TikTok account.
        - avatar string - URL of the account's profile image, as returned by TikTok.
        - verified boolean - True when TikTok has verified the account. For a profile (personal creator) account this reflects the caller's own longUploadsStatus; for a business account it is only filled in once the profile is matched to an already-connected account, so it can be absent on a first-time business connect.
        - isConnected boolean - True when this profile is already attached to the location as a connected account.
        - type string (enum: profile | business) - 'profile' for a personal TikTok creator login (tiktok platform) or 'business' for a TikTok Business Center login (tiktok-business platform).
        - isBusinessAccount boolean - True when this profile was fetched through the TikTok Business API (a tiktok-business connect). Not present on profiles returned for the personal tiktok platform.
  - option 10 Pinterest: object
    - success* boolean - Success or Failure
    - statusCode* number - Status Code
    - message* string - Message
    - results object - Requested Results
      - profile object[] - Pinterest Profile Details
        - id string - Id
        - name string - Name of account
        - username string - Username of account
        - avatar string - Avatar of profile account
        - isConnected boolean - Is connected
        - type string - Pinterest Account Type
        - websiteUrl string - Pinterest Account website Url
      - reconnectDetails string[] - Reconnect Account Details
      - accountId string - Account ID

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get post
GET /social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-post | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-post.md

Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/post.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id
- id* string (e.g. "65fac446d599990d1313c1dd") - Post Id. Accepts either a 24-character post id or a native platform post id (24-hex).

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- message* string - Message
- results object - Requested Results
  - post object - Post Data
    - _id string - Unique identifier of the post
    - source string (enum: composer | csv | recurring | review | rss | template-library | category-queue | native) - source must be one of the following values: composer, recurring, csv
    - locationId* string - Location Id
    - platform string - platform must be one of the following values: google, facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, tiktok
    - displayDate string (format: date-time) - Display date for the post
    - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was created
    - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was last updated
    - accountId string - Account Id
    - error* string - Error
    - postId string - Platform-specific post identifier
    - previewLink string - Direct link to view the published post on the native platform. Populated once the post is published on a platform that returns a permalink; `null` for posts that are not yet published (draft, scheduled, failed) or on platforms that do not return a link.
    - insights object - Aggregated engagement metrics for the published post. Populated asynchronously by the insights sync workers for supported platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube). Absent on posts that have not been synced yet or on platforms where insights are not supported.
      - like number - Number of likes on the published post
      - share number - Number of shares of the published post
      - comment number - Number of comments on the published post
    - publishedAt string - Date when the post was published
    - thumbnail string - Post-level cover image (thumbnail) URL. For posts that contain a video, this is the resolved cover image used for the first video in `media[]`. It is set automatically from the `thumbnail` provided on the first video media item at create/edit time, or auto-generated from the video when one is not supplied. Per-item thumbnails inside `media[]` are not retained on the response — the primary cover image lives on this field.
    - accountIds string[] - Account Ids
    - summary string - Content text of the post
    - media object[] - Post Media Data The limitations of media as per the platforms is provided through the reference link in API description
      - url* string - Public URL of the media file. Must be a valid, accessible HTTPS URL.
      - caption string - Alt text or caption for the media. Used for accessibility and SEO.
      - originalUrl string - Original media URL before any processing (watermarking/optimization). Set automatically by the system.
      - watermarkedUrl string - URL of the media after watermarking. Set automatically when watermark is applied.
      - type* string (enum: image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/png | image/gif | video/mp4 | video/mov | video/webm) - MIME type of the media file. See Platform Limitations Guide for platform-specific format support.
      - thumbnail string - Cover image URL for a video media item. **Scope** - Applies to the **first video** in `media[]`. Values supplied on subsequent video items are ignored. - Has no effect on image-only media items. **Response behavior** - After the post is published, the resolved cover image is surfaced on the post-level `thumbnail` field of the response and is no longer echoed back inside `media[]`. This represents the post's primary cover image and the cover used for the first video. **Limitations** - Per-item thumbnails for multi-video posts are not supported. Each destination network exposes a single cover image per post for the leading video; this matches the behavior of the underlying social platform APIs. **Format** - Provide a publicly accessible JPEG or PNG URL. Animated formats and video URLs are not accepted. - Recommended: an image matching the orientation of your video and ≤ 2 MB.
      - defaultThumb string - Default thumbnail URL, auto-generated from video if not provided.
      - id string - Unique identifier for the media item. Used for tracking and referencing.
      - optimizedUrl string - URL of the optimized/compressed media. Set automatically when media optimization is enabled. **Enable Optimization:** Set `mediaOptimization: true` in the post request.
      - optimizedType string - MIME type of the optimized media. May differ from original if format conversion occurred.
      - isModified boolean - Flag indicating if the media was modified (watermarked, optimized, or processed).
      - altText string - Alt text for accessibility. Supported on Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and LinkedIn image posts (ignored for video and other platforms). Auto-truncated per platform: Pinterest 500, Instagram/Threads 1000, Bluesky 2000, LinkedIn 4086 chars.
    - status string (enum: in_progress | draft | failed | published | scheduled | in_review | notification_sent | pending | deleted) - Status must be one of the following values: in_progress, draft, failed, published, scheduled, in_review, notification_sent, pending, deleted
    - createdBy string - User ID who created the post
    - type* string (enum: post | story | reel | short) - Post Type must be one of the following values: post, story, reel, short
    - tags string[] - Tag Ids
    - ogTagsDetails object - Og Tags Meta Data
      - metaImage string - Preview image URL for the shared link. **Best Practices:** - Use high-quality images (1200x630px recommended) - Ensure the image is publicly accessible **Auto-fetch:** Use the Get Metatags API to fetch OG data from a URL.
      - metaLink string - URL of the webpage being shared. This is the destination when users click the link preview.
      - ogTitle string - Custom title for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:title meta tag. **Tip:** Keep titles concise (50-60 characters) for best display across platforms.
      - ogDescription string - Custom description for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:description meta tag. **Tip:** Keep descriptions under 155 characters for optimal display.
    - postApprovalDetails object - Post Approval Details
      - approver string - User ID of the designated approver. **Note:** The approver will receive a notification when a post is submitted for review.
      - requesterNote string - Note from the post creator to the approver explaining the post or requesting specific feedback.
      - approverNote string - Note from the approver to the post creator with feedback or approval comments.
      - approvalStatus string (enum: pending | approved | rejected | not_required) - Current approval status of the post. **Available Values:** - `pending` - Awaiting approver review - `approved` - Approved and ready for publishing - `rejected` - Rejected by approver (needs revision) - `not_required` - No approval workflow needed
      - approverUser object - Approver User Details
        - id* string - User Id
        - title* string - Title
        - firstName* string - First name
        - lastName* string - Last name
        - profilePhoto* string - Profile photo
        - phone* string - Phone number
        - email* string - Email Id
    - tiktokPostDetails object - Tiktok Post Details
      - privacyLevel string (enum: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | SELF_ONLY) - Privacy level controlling who can view the video. **Available Values:** - `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` - Anyone can view (default) - `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS` - Only mutual followers can view - `SELF_ONLY` - Only you can view (private) **Note:** If set to `SELF_ONLY`, `videoDisclosure` must be `false`.
      - promoteOtherBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes a third-party brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting another brand.
      - enableComment boolean - Allow users to comment on the video. Default is determined by account settings.
      - enableDuet boolean - Allow users to create Duet videos with your content. **Duet:** Side-by-side video featuring your content and the creator's reaction/addition.
      - enableStitch boolean - Allow users to create Stitch videos with your content. **Stitch:** Clips up to 5 seconds of your video that creators can use in their own videos.
      - videoDisclosure boolean - Enable branded content disclosure. Required when video is promotional content. **Validations:** - Cannot be `true` if `privacyLevel` is `SELF_ONLY` - If enabled, at least one of `promoteYourBrand` or `promoteOtherBrand` must be `true`
      - promoteYourBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes your own brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting your own brand.
    - gmbPostDetails object - GMB Post Details
      - gmbEventType* string (enum: STANDARD | EVENT | OFFER) - Google My Business post type. **Available Types:** - `STANDARD` - Regular update post (What's New) - `EVENT` - Event announcement with dates and title - `OFFER` - Promotional offer with coupon and redemption details **Required fields by type:** - STANDARD: None additional - EVENT: `title`, `startDate`, `endDate` - OFFER: `offerTitle`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `termsConditions`, `couponCode`, `redeemOnlineUrl`
      - title string - Event title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `EVENT`. **Max length:** 58 characters
      - offerTitle string - Offer title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `OFFER`.
      - startDate object - Start date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Structure:** - `startDate`: { year, month, day } - `startTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
        - startDate object - Start Date
          - year* number - Year component of the date
          - month* number - Month component of the date (1-12)
          - day* number - Day component of the date (1-31)
        - startTime object - Start Time
          - hours* number - Hour component of the time (0-23)
          - minutes* number - Minute component of the time (0-59)
          - seconds* number - Second component of the time (0-59)
      - endDate object - End date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Validation:** Must be after `startDate`. **Structure:** - `endDate`: { year, month, day } - `endTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
        - endDate object - End Date
          - year* number - Year component of the date
          - month* number - Month component of the date (1-12)
          - day* number - Day component of the date (1-31)
        - endTime object - End Time
          - hours* number - Hour component of the time (0-23)
          - minutes* number - Minute component of the time (0-59)
          - seconds* number - Second component of the time (0-59)
      - termsConditions string - URL to terms and conditions page. Required for OFFER posts.
      - url string - Call-to-action URL. Required when `actionType` is set (except `none` and `call`). **Required for:** STANDARD and EVENT posts with actionType other than `none` or `call`.
      - couponCode string - Promotional coupon code. Required for OFFER posts.
      - redeemOnlineUrl string - URL where customers can redeem the offer online. Required for OFFER posts.
      - actionType string (enum: none | order | book | shop | learn_more | call | sign_up) - Call-to-action button type for the post. **Available Actions:** - `none` - No action button - `order` - Order online - `book` - Book appointment - `shop` - Shop now - `learn_more` - Learn more - `call` - Call now (no URL required) - `sign_up` - Sign up **Note:** All actions except `none` and `call` require a `url`.
    - blueskyPostDetails object - Bluesky Post Details
      - shortenedLinks string[] - Shortened links for the post (auto-generated).
      - replyTo string - Bluesky AT Protocol URI of a post to reply to. **Format:** `at://did:plc:{user-id}/app.bsky.feed.post/{post-id}` **Use Case:** Create a reply thread to an existing Bluesky post.
      - quotePost string - Bluesky AT Protocol URI of a post to quote. **Format:** `at://did:plc:{user-id}/app.bsky.feed.post/{post-id}` **Use Case:** Quote-post another user's post with your commentary.
      - language string - ISO 639-1 language code for the post content. **Examples:** `en` (English), `es` (Spanish), `fr` (French), `de` (German)
      - externalLink string - External URL to embed as a link card in the post.
      - externalLinkTitle string - Title for the external link card. Displayed prominently in the embed.
      - externalLinkDescription string - Description for the external link card. Brief summary displayed below the title.
    - user object - User
      - id* string - User Id
      - title* string - Title
      - firstName* string - First name
      - lastName* string - Last name
      - profilePhoto* string - Profile photo
      - phone* string - Phone number
      - email* string - Email Id
    - linkedinPostDetails object - Linkedin Post Details
      - pdfTitle string - Title for the PDF document carousel. Displayed as the document name on LinkedIn. **Max length:** 100 characters **Tip:** Use a descriptive title that explains the document content.
      - postAsPdf boolean - Post images as a PDF document carousel. **Limits:** - Max 300 pages/images - Max PDF size: 100 MB
      - poll object - Publish a LinkedIn poll post. **Required fields when `poll` is supplied:** - `question` (max 140 characters) - `options`: 2 to 4 entries, each `text` ≤ 30 characters; option texts must be unique - `settings.duration`: one of `ONE_DAY`, `THREE_DAYS`, `SEVEN_DAYS`, `FOURTEEN_DAYS` **LinkedIn restrictions:** - Polls cannot be edited after publishing. - A poll post cannot include `media` or a meta-link preview.
        - question* string (maxLength: 140) - Question for the poll. Max length: 140 characters.
        - options* object[] (minItems: 2; maxItems: 4) - Poll options. Minimum 2, maximum 4. Each option text max 30 characters. Option texts must be unique.
          - text* string (maxLength: 30) - Text describing the option. Max length: 30 characters.
        - settings* object - Poll settings (duration).
          - duration* string (enum: ONE_DAY | THREE_DAYS | SEVEN_DAYS | FOURTEEN_DAYS) - Duration the poll stays open for votes.
    - pinterestPostDetails object - Pinterest Post Details
      - title string - Pin title displayed on Pinterest. **Max length:** 100 characters **Best Practices:** - Include relevant keywords - Be descriptive and engaging
      - link string - Destination URL for the pin. Users clicking the pin will be directed to this URL. **Max length:** 2048 characters **Best Practices:** - Use direct links to relevant content - Track with UTM parameters for analytics
      - boardIds map<string, string> (deprecated) - **DEPRECATED — use `pinterestBoards` instead.** Will be removed on July 31, 2026. Legacy mapping of Pinterest account OAuth IDs to a single board ID: `{ accountOAuthId: "boardId" }` For multi-board posting, use `pinterestBoards`.
      - pinterestBoards object[] - Per-account Pinterest board selection. Each entry binds one connected Pinterest account to a list of boards on that account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account. When supplied, this field takes precedence over the deprecated `boardIds` field.
        - accountId* string - Connected Pinterest account ID. Must match one of the accounts referenced in the post's `userIds`.
        - boards* string[] - Pinterest board IDs to publish to on this account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account.
      - shortenedLinks string[] - Shortened links for the post (auto-generated).
    - facebookPostDetails object - Facebook Post Details
      - type* string (enum: post | story | reel) - Facebook post format type. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, text) - `story` - 24-hour temporary story - `reel` - Short-form vertical video **Restrictions:** - Reels: Require exactly 1 video, not supported on Groups - Stories: Captions not supported
      - textFormatPresetId string - Facebook background preset ID for text-only feed posts. **Facebook `post` only** — not `story` or `reel`. Ignored when media is attached; `metaLink` is omitted on publish. **Validations** — request returns `400` if violated: - Must be a valid preset ID from the [Facebook text background preset reference](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008005-facebook-text-background-posts-preset-reference). Empty strings, whitespace-only values, and `null` are rejected. - When set, `summary` must be 130 characters or fewer.
    - instagramPostDetails object - Instagram Post Details
      - type* string (enum: post | story | reel) - Instagram post format type. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, carousels) - `story` - 24-hour temporary story - `reel` - Short-form vertical video (up to 90 seconds) **Restrictions:** - Media is REQUIRED for all Instagram posts - Reels: Require exactly 1 video - Stories: Captions not supported, JPEG only for images
      - collaborators object - Collaboration invites mapping account IDs to Instagram usernames. **Structure:** `{ accountId: [username1, username2, username3] }` - **Key:** Account ID from `accountIds` array (the Instagram account posting) - **Value:** Array of Instagram usernames to invite as collaborators **Get Account IDs from:** [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) — use the `id` field from Instagram accounts. **✅ Supported for:** Posts and Reels only (NOT Stories) **Validations:** - Maximum 5 collaborators per account - No duplicate usernames allowed - Usernames are Instagram handles without @ **Use Case:** Invite other Instagram users to collaborate. Once accepted, the post appears on both profiles.
      - publishViaPushNotification boolean - Send Instagram Story via Push Notification instead of direct posting. Only applicable for Story type.
      - publisherNote string - Note to the publisher for manual posting guidance. Only used when publishViaPushNotification is true.
      - notificationSentCount number - Number of push notifications sent for this Instagram Story. Tracks how many notifications have been sent out.
      - postedVia string (enum: web | mobile) - Source of where the post was marked as published. Values: "web" (web interface), "mobile" (mobile app), or null.
      - showOnFeed boolean - Show Reel on profile grid/feed. **✅ Applies to:** Reels only - `true` - Reel appears on your profile grid - `false` - Reel only appears in Reels tab
    - youtubePostDetails object - Youtube Post Details
      - title string - Video title displayed on YouTube. **Max length:** 100 characters **Best Practices:** - Include relevant keywords - Be descriptive but concise - Avoid clickbait
      - privacyLevel string (enum: private | public | unlisted) - Video visibility/privacy setting. **Available Values:** - `public` - Anyone can search and view - `unlisted` - Only people with the link can view - `private` - Only you can view
      - type* string (enum: video | short) - YouTube video format type. **Available Types:** - `video` - Standard YouTube video (landscape, any duration) - `short` - YouTube Shorts (vertical, up to 60 seconds) **Required field.**
    - communityPostDetails object - Community Post Details
      - title* string - Title of the community post. Displayed as the post headline. **Max length:** 1,000 characters **Required:** Yes, for all Community posts.
      - notifyAllGroupMembers boolean - Notify every member of the group when the post is published, equivalent to an `@everyone` broadcast prepended to the post content. **Use Case:** Enable for announcements that all members should see. **Default:** `false`
      - postAsUser* object - The Community member each post is published as, keyed by Community account ID. **Structure:** `{ accountId: { id, name, avatar } }` - **Key** — the Community account ID. This is the same value you pass in `accountIds`: take it from the `id` field of a Community account in the Get Accounts API, not the `oauthId` field. - `id` (required) — `contactId` of the member to publish as, from the Get Community Members API. - `name` (optional) — display name shown as the post author. - `avatar` (optional) — profile image URL shown against the post. **Required:** Yes. Every Community account listed in `accountIds` must have an entry here, otherwise the request is rejected. **Member eligibility:** the member must be an active member of the group and hold a role in it. This is checked again at publish time, so a member who leaves the group or loses access between scheduling and publishing causes that post to fail. Use the Validate Community Member API to confirm a stored member is still eligible before scheduling. **Private channels:** list members per account rather than reusing one list across accounts — for a private channel only that channel's members may be posted as.
    - mediaOptimization boolean - Pass this parameter to optimize the image media

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get posts
POST /social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts/list
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/{locationId}/posts/list
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-posts | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-posts.md

Scheduled for removal in a future version.

Get Posts

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/post.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID (also known as Sub-Account ID) for the business location.

Request body (required) (application/json) SearchPostDTO:
- type string (default: all) - type must be one of the following values: recent, all, scheduled, draft, failed, in_review, published, in_progress, pending and deleted
- accounts string - List of account Ids separated by comma as a string
- skip string (default: 0) - Number of records to skip for pagination. Send as a numeric string — a JSON number is rejected.
- limit string (default: 10) - Maximum number of records to return. Send as a numeric string — a JSON number is rejected.
- fromDate string (e.g. "2024-01-22T05:32:49.463Z") - From Date
- toDate string (e.g. "2024-03-20T05:32:49.463Z") - To Date
- includeUsers string (e.g. "true") - Include User Data
- postType string (enum: post | story | reel; e.g. "post") - Post Type must be one of the following values: post, story, reel, short Matches the top-level `type` a post was created with (see the `type` field on Create Post), so only these three values can ever match a post.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- success* boolean - Success or Failure
- statusCode* number - Status Code
- message* string - Message
- results object - Requested Results
  - posts object[] - Post Data
    - _id string - Unique identifier of the post
    - source string (enum: composer | csv | recurring | review | rss | template-library | category-queue | native) - source must be one of the following values: composer, recurring, csv
    - locationId* string - Location Id
    - platform string - platform must be one of the following values: google, facebook, instagram, linkedin, twitter, tiktok
    - displayDate string (format: date-time) - Display date for the post
    - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was created
    - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Date when the post was last updated
    - accountId string - Account Id
    - error* string - Error
    - postId string - Platform-specific post identifier
    - previewLink string - Direct link to view the published post on the native platform. Populated once the post is published on a platform that returns a permalink; `null` for posts that are not yet published (draft, scheduled, failed) or on platforms that do not return a link.
    - insights object - Aggregated engagement metrics for the published post. Populated asynchronously by the insights sync workers for supported platforms (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube). Absent on posts that have not been synced yet or on platforms where insights are not supported.
      - like number - Number of likes on the published post
      - share number - Number of shares of the published post
      - comment number - Number of comments on the published post
    - publishedAt string - Date when the post was published
    - thumbnail string - Post-level cover image (thumbnail) URL. For posts that contain a video, this is the resolved cover image used for the first video in `media[]`. It is set automatically from the `thumbnail` provided on the first video media item at create/edit time, or auto-generated from the video when one is not supplied. Per-item thumbnails inside `media[]` are not retained on the response — the primary cover image lives on this field.
    - accountIds string[] - Account Ids
    - summary string - Content text of the post
    - media object[] - Post Media Data The limitations of media as per the platforms is provided through the reference link in API description
      - url* string - Public URL of the media file. Must be a valid, accessible HTTPS URL.
      - caption string - Alt text or caption for the media. Used for accessibility and SEO.
      - originalUrl string - Original media URL before any processing (watermarking/optimization). Set automatically by the system.
      - watermarkedUrl string - URL of the media after watermarking. Set automatically when watermark is applied.
      - type* string (enum: image/jpeg | image/jpg | image/png | image/gif | video/mp4 | video/mov | video/webm) - MIME type of the media file. See Platform Limitations Guide for platform-specific format support.
      - thumbnail string - Cover image URL for a video media item. **Scope** - Applies to the **first video** in `media[]`. Values supplied on subsequent video items are ignored. - Has no effect on image-only media items. **Response behavior** - After the post is published, the resolved cover image is surfaced on the post-level `thumbnail` field of the response and is no longer echoed back inside `media[]`. This represents the post's primary cover image and the cover used for the first video. **Limitations** - Per-item thumbnails for multi-video posts are not supported. Each destination network exposes a single cover image per post for the leading video; this matches the behavior of the underlying social platform APIs. **Format** - Provide a publicly accessible JPEG or PNG URL. Animated formats and video URLs are not accepted. - Recommended: an image matching the orientation of your video and ≤ 2 MB.
      - defaultThumb string - Default thumbnail URL, auto-generated from video if not provided.
      - id string - Unique identifier for the media item. Used for tracking and referencing.
      - optimizedUrl string - URL of the optimized/compressed media. Set automatically when media optimization is enabled. **Enable Optimization:** Set `mediaOptimization: true` in the post request.
      - optimizedType string - MIME type of the optimized media. May differ from original if format conversion occurred.
      - isModified boolean - Flag indicating if the media was modified (watermarked, optimized, or processed).
      - altText string - Alt text for accessibility. Supported on Instagram, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, and LinkedIn image posts (ignored for video and other platforms). Auto-truncated per platform: Pinterest 500, Instagram/Threads 1000, Bluesky 2000, LinkedIn 4086 chars.
    - status string (enum: in_progress | draft | failed | published | scheduled | in_review | notification_sent | pending | deleted) - Status must be one of the following values: in_progress, draft, failed, published, scheduled, in_review, notification_sent, pending, deleted
    - createdBy string - User ID who created the post
    - type* string (enum: post | story | reel | short) - Post Type must be one of the following values: post, story, reel, short
    - tags string[] - Tag Ids
    - ogTagsDetails object - Og Tags Meta Data
      - metaImage string - Preview image URL for the shared link. **Best Practices:** - Use high-quality images (1200x630px recommended) - Ensure the image is publicly accessible **Auto-fetch:** Use the Get Metatags API to fetch OG data from a URL.
      - metaLink string - URL of the webpage being shared. This is the destination when users click the link preview.
      - ogTitle string - Custom title for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:title meta tag. **Tip:** Keep titles concise (50-60 characters) for best display across platforms.
      - ogDescription string - Custom description for the link preview. Overrides the page's og:description meta tag. **Tip:** Keep descriptions under 155 characters for optimal display.
    - postApprovalDetails object - Post Approval Details
      - approver string - User ID of the designated approver. **Note:** The approver will receive a notification when a post is submitted for review.
      - requesterNote string - Note from the post creator to the approver explaining the post or requesting specific feedback.
      - approverNote string - Note from the approver to the post creator with feedback or approval comments.
      - approvalStatus string (enum: pending | approved | rejected | not_required) - Current approval status of the post. **Available Values:** - `pending` - Awaiting approver review - `approved` - Approved and ready for publishing - `rejected` - Rejected by approver (needs revision) - `not_required` - No approval workflow needed
      - approverUser object - Approver User Details
        - id* string - User Id
        - title* string - Title
        - firstName* string - First name
        - lastName* string - Last name
        - profilePhoto* string - Profile photo
        - phone* string - Phone number
        - email* string - Email Id
    - tiktokPostDetails object - Tiktok Post Details
      - privacyLevel string (enum: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | SELF_ONLY) - Privacy level controlling who can view the video. **Available Values:** - `PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE` - Anyone can view (default) - `MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS` - Only mutual followers can view - `SELF_ONLY` - Only you can view (private) **Note:** If set to `SELF_ONLY`, `videoDisclosure` must be `false`.
      - promoteOtherBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes a third-party brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting another brand.
      - enableComment boolean - Allow users to comment on the video. Default is determined by account settings.
      - enableDuet boolean - Allow users to create Duet videos with your content. **Duet:** Side-by-side video featuring your content and the creator's reaction/addition.
      - enableStitch boolean - Allow users to create Stitch videos with your content. **Stitch:** Clips up to 5 seconds of your video that creators can use in their own videos.
      - videoDisclosure boolean - Enable branded content disclosure. Required when video is promotional content. **Validations:** - Cannot be `true` if `privacyLevel` is `SELF_ONLY` - If enabled, at least one of `promoteYourBrand` or `promoteOtherBrand` must be `true`
      - promoteYourBrand boolean - Indicates if the video promotes your own brand or product. **Required:** Must be `true` if `videoDisclosure` is enabled and you're promoting your own brand.
    - gmbPostDetails object - GMB Post Details
      - gmbEventType* string (enum: STANDARD | EVENT | OFFER) - Google My Business post type. **Available Types:** - `STANDARD` - Regular update post (What's New) - `EVENT` - Event announcement with dates and title - `OFFER` - Promotional offer with coupon and redemption details **Required fields by type:** - STANDARD: None additional - EVENT: `title`, `startDate`, `endDate` - OFFER: `offerTitle`, `startDate`, `endDate`, `termsConditions`, `couponCode`, `redeemOnlineUrl`
      - title string - Event title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `EVENT`. **Max length:** 58 characters
      - offerTitle string - Offer title. Required when `gmbEventType` is `OFFER`.
      - startDate object - Start date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Structure:** - `startDate`: { year, month, day } - `startTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
        - startDate object - Start Date
          - year* number - Year component of the date
          - month* number - Month component of the date (1-12)
          - day* number - Day component of the date (1-31)
        - startTime object - Start Time
          - hours* number - Hour component of the time (0-23)
          - minutes* number - Minute component of the time (0-59)
          - seconds* number - Second component of the time (0-59)
      - endDate object - End date and time for EVENT or OFFER posts. **Required:** When `gmbEventType` is `EVENT` or `OFFER`. **Validation:** Must be after `startDate`. **Structure:** - `endDate`: { year, month, day } - `endTime`: { hours, minutes, seconds }
        - endDate object - End Date
          - year* number - Year component of the date
          - month* number - Month component of the date (1-12)
          - day* number - Day component of the date (1-31)
        - endTime object - End Time
          - hours* number - Hour component of the time (0-23)
          - minutes* number - Minute component of the time (0-59)
          - seconds* number - Second component of the time (0-59)
      - termsConditions string - URL to terms and conditions page. Required for OFFER posts.
      - url string - Call-to-action URL. Required when `actionType` is set (except `none` and `call`). **Required for:** STANDARD and EVENT posts with actionType other than `none` or `call`.
      - couponCode string - Promotional coupon code. Required for OFFER posts.
      - redeemOnlineUrl string - URL where customers can redeem the offer online. Required for OFFER posts.
      - actionType string (enum: none | order | book | shop | learn_more | call | sign_up) - Call-to-action button type for the post. **Available Actions:** - `none` - No action button - `order` - Order online - `book` - Book appointment - `shop` - Shop now - `learn_more` - Learn more - `call` - Call now (no URL required) - `sign_up` - Sign up **Note:** All actions except `none` and `call` require a `url`.
    - blueskyPostDetails object - Bluesky Post Details
      - shortenedLinks string[] - Shortened links for the post (auto-generated).
      - replyTo string - Bluesky AT Protocol URI of a post to reply to. **Format:** `at://did:plc:{user-id}/app.bsky.feed.post/{post-id}` **Use Case:** Create a reply thread to an existing Bluesky post.
      - quotePost string - Bluesky AT Protocol URI of a post to quote. **Format:** `at://did:plc:{user-id}/app.bsky.feed.post/{post-id}` **Use Case:** Quote-post another user's post with your commentary.
      - language string - ISO 639-1 language code for the post content. **Examples:** `en` (English), `es` (Spanish), `fr` (French), `de` (German)
      - externalLink string - External URL to embed as a link card in the post.
      - externalLinkTitle string - Title for the external link card. Displayed prominently in the embed.

    - user object - User
      - id* string - User Id
      - title* string - Title
      - firstName* string - First name
      - lastName* string - Last name
      - profilePhoto* string - Profile photo
      - phone* string - Phone number
      - email* string - Email Id
    - linkedinPostDetails object - Linkedin Post Details
      - pdfTitle string - Title for the PDF document carousel. Displayed as the document name on LinkedIn. **Max length:** 100 characters **Tip:** Use a descriptive title that explains the document content.
      - postAsPdf boolean - Post images as a PDF document carousel. **Limits:** - Max 300 pages/images - Max PDF size: 100 MB
      - poll object - Publish a LinkedIn poll post. **Required fields when `poll` is supplied:** - `question` (max 140 characters) - `options`: 2 to 4 entries, each `text` ≤ 30 characters; option texts must be unique - `settings.duration`: one of `ONE_DAY`, `THREE_DAYS`, `SEVEN_DAYS`, `FOURTEEN_DAYS` **LinkedIn restrictions:** - Polls cannot be edited after publishing. - A poll post cannot include `media` or a meta-link preview.
        - question* string (maxLength: 140) - Question for the poll. Max length: 140 characters.
        - options* object[] (minItems: 2; maxItems: 4) - Poll options. Minimum 2, maximum 4. Each option text max 30 characters. Option texts must be unique.
          - text* string (maxLength: 30) - Text describing the option. Max length: 30 characters.
        - settings* object - Poll settings (duration).
          - duration* string (enum: ONE_DAY | THREE_DAYS | SEVEN_DAYS | FOURTEEN_DAYS) - Duration the poll stays open for votes.
    - pinterestPostDetails object - Pinterest Post Details
      - title string - Pin title displayed on Pinterest. **Max length:** 100 characters **Best Practices:** - Include relevant keywords - Be descriptive and engaging
      - link string - Destination URL for the pin. Users clicking the pin will be directed to this URL. **Max length:** 2048 characters **Best Practices:** - Use direct links to relevant content - Track with UTM parameters for analytics
      - boardIds map<string, string> (deprecated) - **DEPRECATED — use `pinterestBoards` instead.** Will be removed on July 31, 2026. Legacy mapping of Pinterest account OAuth IDs to a single board ID: `{ accountOAuthId: "boardId" }` For multi-board posting, use `pinterestBoards`.
      - pinterestBoards object[] - Per-account Pinterest board selection. Each entry binds one connected Pinterest account to a list of boards on that account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account. When supplied, this field takes precedence over the deprecated `boardIds` field.
        - accountId* string - Connected Pinterest account ID. Must match one of the accounts referenced in the post's `userIds`.
        - boards* string[] - Pinterest board IDs to publish to on this account. Each board produces an independent child post tracked separately for success/failure. Capped at 25 boards per account.
      - shortenedLinks string[] - Shortened links for the post (auto-generated).
    - facebookPostDetails object - Facebook Post Details
      - type* string (enum: post | story | reel) - Facebook post format type. **Available Types:** - `post` - Standard feed post (images, videos, text) - `story` - 24-hour temporary story - `reel` - Short-form vertical video **Restrictions:** - Reels: Require exactly 1 video, not supported on Groups - Stories: Captions not supported
      - textFormatPresetId string - Facebook background preset ID for text-only feed posts. **Facebook `post` only** — not `story` or `reel`. Ignored when media is attached; `metaLink` is omitted on publish. **Validations** — request returns `400` if violated: - Must be a valid preset ID from the [Facebook text background preset reference](https://help.leadconnectorhq.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008005-facebook-text-background-posts-preset-reference). Empty strings, whitespace-only values, and `null` are rejected. - When set, `summary` must be 130 characters or fewer.
    - instagramPostDetails object - Instagram Post Details

      - collaborators object - Collaboration invites mapping account IDs to Instagram usernames. **Structure:** `{ accountId: [username1, username2, username3] }` - **Key:** Account ID from `accountIds` array (the Instagram account posting) - **Value:** Array of Instagram usernames to invite as collaborators **Get Account IDs from:** [Get Accounts API](/social-media-posting/oauth/{locationId}/accounts) — use the `id` field from Instagram accounts. **✅ Supported for:** Posts and Reels only (NOT Stories) **Validations:** - Maximum 5 collaborators per account - No duplicate usernames allowed - Usernames are Instagram handles without @ **Use Case:** Invite other Instagram users to collaborate. Once accepted, the post appears on both profiles.
      - publishViaPushNotification boolean - Send Instagram Story via Push Notification instead of direct posting. Only applicable for Story type.

    - youtubePostDetails object - Youtube Post Details

      - privacyLevel string (enum: private | public | unlisted) - Video visibility/privacy setting. **Available Values:** - `public` - Anyone can search and view - `unlisted` - Only people with the link can view - `private` - Only you can view
      - type* string (enum: video | short) - YouTube video format type. **Available Types:** - `video` - Standard YouTube video (landscape, any duration) - `short` - YouTube Shorts (vertical, up to 60 seconds) **Required field.**
    - communityPostDetails object - Community Post Details

      - notifyAllGroupMembers boolean - Notify every member of the group when the post is published, equivalent to an `@everyone` broadcast prepended to the post content. **Use Case:** Enable for announcements that all members should see. **Default:** `false`
      - postAsUser* object - The Community member each post is published as, keyed by Community account ID. **Structure:** `{ accountId: { id, name, avatar } }` - **Key** — the Community account ID. This is the same value you pass in `accountIds`: take it from the `id` field of a Community account in the Get Accounts API, not the `oauthId` field. - `id` (required) — `contactId` of the member to publish as, from the Get Community Members API. - `name` (optional) — display name shown as the post author. - `avatar` (optional) — profile image URL shown against the post. **Required:** Yes. This is checked again at publish time, so a member who leaves the group or loses access between scheduling and publishing causes that post to fail. Use the Validate Community Member API to confirm a stored member is still eligible before scheduling. **Private channels:** list members per account rather than reusing one list across accounts — for a private channel only that channel's members may be posted as.
    - mediaOptimization boolean - Pass this parameter to optimize the image media
  - count number - Total count of posts

### Get Social Media Statistics
POST /social-media-posting/statistics
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/social-media-posting/statistics
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-statistics | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/social-planner/get-statistics.md

Retrieve analytics data for multiple social media accounts. Supports custom date ranges for both the current period and a comparison period. If no date ranges are provided, defaults to the last 7 days (excluding today) with comparison to the previous 7 days.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: socialplanner/statistics.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID (also known as Sub-Account ID) for the business location.

Request body (required) (application/json) GetAnalyticsBodyDTOV2:
- profileIds string[] (maxItems: 100; e.g. ["6673d4f770801753dcafd7b8_SovchenxzWl9R3OFPgsj_9285776684082983366"]) - Array of connected social media account IDs to fetch analytics for. Limited to 100 accounts maximum.
- platforms string[] (enum: facebook | instagram | linkedin | google | pinterest | youtube | tiktok; e.g. ["facebook","instagram","linkedin","google","pinterest","youtube","tiktok"]) - Array of social media platforms to filter analytics by. If not provided, all platforms will be included.
- currentRange object - Current date range for analytics. If not provided, defaults to the last 7 days (excluding today) with comparison to the previous 7 days.
  - startDate* string (e.g. "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z") - Start date (ISO 8601 format)
  - endDate* string (e.g. "2025-01-07T23:59:59.999Z") - End date (ISO 8601 format)
- prevRange object - Comparison date range. If not provided, no comparison will be made.
  - startDate* string (e.g. "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z") - Start date (ISO 8601 format)
  - endDate* string (e.g. "2025-01-07T23:59:59.999Z") - End date (ISO 8601 format)

Response 200 (Successfully retrieved analytics data) application/json:
- results* object - Analytics data grouped by metrics and platforms for the requested accounts and date range.
  - dayRange* string[] - Display label for each time bucket in the period (weekday name for daily grouping, or a date-range label for bidaily/weekly/monthly/yearly grouping).
  - grouping* string (enum: daily | bidaily | weekly | monthly | yearly) - Time-bucket granularity used to build this response, derived from the length of the requested date range (daily up to 10 days, bidaily up to 20 days, weekly up to 60 days, otherwise monthly or yearly).
  - totals* object - Aggregated metric totals for the current period.
    - posts* number - Total number of posts published across all requested accounts in the period.
    - likes* number - Total number of likes received across all requested accounts in the period.
    - followers* number - Total number of followers across all requested accounts.
    - impressions* number - Total number of impressions across all posts in the period.
    - comments* number - Total number of comments received across all requested accounts in the period.
  - postPerformance* object - Post performance metrics over time, split by platform and by overall daily/bucketed totals.
    - posts* map<string, number[]> - Number of posts published per time bucket, keyed by platform name.
    - impressions* number[] - Total impressions per time bucket, summed across all platforms.
    - likes* number[] - Total likes per time bucket, summed across all platforms.
    - comments* number[] - Total comments per time bucket, summed across all platforms.
  - breakdowns* object - Detailed breakdowns by metric (posts, impressions, reach, engagement) and platform, including percentage change versus the comparison period.
    - posts* object - Post count breakdown by platform.
      - total* number - Total value for this metric across all platforms.
      - totalChange* number - Percentage change in the total versus the previous comparison period.
      - platforms* map<string, object> - Per-platform value and percentage change, keyed by platform name.
        - value* number - Metric value for this platform in the current period.
        - change* number - Percentage change versus the previous comparison period. 0 when there is no previous period or the previous value was 0.
    - impressions* object - Impressions breakdown by platform.
      - total* number - Total value for this metric across all platforms.
      - totalChange* number - Percentage change in the total versus the previous comparison period.
      - platforms* map<string, object> - Per-platform value and percentage change, keyed by platform name.
        - value* number - Metric value for this platform in the current period.
        - change* number - Percentage change versus the previous comparison period. 0 when there is no previous period or the previous value was 0.
    - reach* object - Reach breakdown by platform.
      - total* number - Total value for this metric across all platforms.
      - totalChange* number - Percentage change in the total versus the previous comparison period.
      - platforms* map<string, object> - Per-platform value and percentage change, keyed by platform name.
        - value* number - Metric value for this platform in the current period.
        - change* number - Percentage change versus the previous comparison period. 0 when there is no previous period or the previous value was 0.
    - engagement* map<string, object> - Engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, change), keyed by platform name.
      - likes* number - Number of likes received on this platform.
      - comments* number - Number of comments received on this platform.
      - shares* number - Number of shares on this platform.
      - change* number - Percentage change in total engagement (likes + comments + shares) versus the previous period.
  - platformTotals* object - Platform-wise totals with per-time-bucket series data for impressions, followers and likes.
    - impressions* map<string, object> - Daily impression totals and series, keyed by platform name.
      - total* number - Total value for this platform across the whole period.
      - series* number[] - Per-time-bucket values for this platform, aligned index-for-index with results.dayRange.
    - followers* map<string, object> - Daily follower totals and series, keyed by platform name.
      - total* number - Total value for this platform across the whole period.
      - series* number[] - Per-time-bucket values for this platform, aligned index-for-index with results.dayRange.
    - likes* map<string, object> - Daily like totals and series, keyed by platform name.
      - total* number - Total value for this platform across the whole period.
      - series* number[] - Per-time-bucket values for this platform, aligned index-for-index with results.dayRange.
  - demographics* object - Audience demographic breakdown by gender and age. Currently only populated for Instagram accounts.
    - gender* object - Gender distribution of the audience. Currently only populated from Instagram accounts.
      - totals* object - Total counts and percentages by gender.
        - male* object - Male audience statistics.
          - total* number - Total number of audience members in this gender bucket.
          - percentage* number - Percentage of the total audience this gender bucket represents.
        - female* object - Female audience statistics.
          - total* number - Total number of audience members in this gender bucket.
          - percentage* number - Percentage of the total audience this gender bucket represents.
        - unknown* object - Audience statistics for followers with unspecified gender.
          - total* number - Total number of audience members in this gender bucket.
          - percentage* number - Percentage of the total audience this gender bucket represents.
    - age* object - Age distribution of the audience. Currently only populated from Instagram accounts.
      - totals* map<string, number> - Total audience count per age group, keyed by age range. Keys are `13-17`, `18-24`, `25-34`, `35-44`, `45-54`, `55-64` and `65+`.
- message* string - Human-readable status message confirming the analytics were built successfully.
- traceId* string - Trace ID for debugging

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
